O governador da Califórnia, Gavin Newsom, do Partido Democrata, classificou o presidente republicano como “desequilibrado e perigoso”. “Depois de enviar a Guarda Nacional e os fuzileiros navais para ocupar a Califórnia, Donald Trump agora está dizendo que nossos inimigos estrangeiros deveriam ‘destruir’ Los Angeles e San Diego”, escreveu ele no X. Newsom, que se posiciona como um importante adversário político de Trump e é visto como um potencial candidato à Presidência em 2028, justapôs um trecho de vídeo de Trump em Nebraska com menção à retórica anterior do presidente para justificar o envio de tropas militares dos EUA a Los Angeles e outras cidades para combater o crime e fazer cumprir as leis de imigração. A votação antecipada da Califórnia para as eleições de meio de mandato de novembro começou na segunda-feira. O Partido Republicano do presidente espera conquistar vitórias no Estado, incluindo a eleição para governador deste ano. Um dos republicanos concorrendo em uma disputa acirrada em um distrito redesenhado da Califórnia próximo a San Diego, Jim Desmond, se distanciou das declarações de Trump. “Discordo veementemente dos comentários do presidente Trump. Os EUA precisam enfrentar o Irã e defender nossos interesses, mas a primeira responsabilidade do nosso comandante-chefe é proteger o povo norte-americano e nossa pátria”, escreveu ele no X. “Nenhuma cidade norte-americana é dispensável, e nenhuma família norte-americana deve jamais ser tratada como dano colateral.” A prefeita de Los Angeles, Karen Bass, democrata e ex-deputada federal, também repreendeu Trump por seus comentários. “O presidente dos Estados Unidos sugeriu que um governo estrangeiro atacasse Los Angeles. Suas declarações contra nossa cidade são perigosas e podem comprometer nossa segurança”, afirmou Bass em comunicado. Los Angeles e San Diego são, respectivamente, a maior e a segunda maior cidade da Califórnia em termos de população.

item.title: Importaciones soja UE en campaña 2026/27 caen 9% al 4 de octubre
item.description: Las importaciones de soja de la Unión Europea para la campaña 2026/27, que comenzó en julio, alcanzaron los 3,06 millones de toneladas métricas al 4 de octubre, un descenso del 9% respecto al mismo periodo del año anterior, según datos de la Comisión Europea publicados el martes.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Las importaciones de soja de la Unión Europea para la campaña 2026/27, que comenzó en julio, alcanzaron los 3,06 millones de toneladas métricas al 4 de octubre, un descenso del 9% respecto al mismo periodo del año anterior, según datos de la Comisión Europea publicados el martes. Las importaciones de colza de la UE en el mismo periodo fueron de 0,95 millones de toneladas, un 10% menos que el año anterior. Por su parte, las importaciones de harina de soja cayeron un 22% a 4,40 millones de toneladas. Las importaciones de aceite de palma de la UE se situaron en 0,71 millones de toneladas, un 18% menos que el año anterior.

item.title: Nigeria nears 2,000 repatriations from South Africa after latest evacuation flight
item.description: Another 105 Nigerians arrived in Lagos from South Africa on Friday, bringing to 1,926 the number repatriated since June following xenophobic attacks, the foreign ministry said on Tuesday.
item.dc:creator: Camillus Eboh
item.content:encoded: Another 105 Nigerians arrived in Lagos from South Africa on Friday, bringing to 1,926 the [USN:L8N43I1PT TEXT:"number repatriated"] since June following xenophobic attacks, the foreign ministry said on Tuesday. Foreign ministry spokesperson Oluwafemi Adeniyi said the latest group was comprised of 26 men, 29 women and 50 children. The latest group was the 14th consular evacuation flight from South Africa since the evacuation programme began on June 10, Adeniyi said. The exercise is continuing, with more Nigerians undergoing verification and clearance in South Africa ahead of planned repatriation flights. Abuja said it was working with South African authorities to tackle xenophobic violence, while urging Nigerians in the country to be vigilant, obey local laws and stay in contact with its mission in Pretoria for consular assistance.

item.title: Exportaciones de trigo blando de la UE en campaña 2026/27 suben 1% al 4 de octubre
item.description: Las exportaciones de trigo blando de la Unión Europea para la campaña 2026/27, que comenzó en julio, ascendían a 7,52 millones de toneladas métricas al 4 de octubre, un aumento respecto a los 6,81 millones de toneladas de la semana anterior y un 1% más que en el mismo periodo del año anterior, según datos de la Comisión Europea publicados el martes.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Las exportaciones de trigo blando de la Unión Europea para la campaña 2026/27, que comenzó en julio, ascendían a 7,52 millones de toneladas métricas al 4 de octubre, un aumento respecto a los 6,81 millones de toneladas de la semana anterior y un 1% más que en el mismo periodo del año anterior, según datos de la Comisión Europea publicados el martes. Rumania fue el mayor exportador de trigo blando de la UE en lo que va de temporada con 3,28 millones de toneladas, seguida de Lituania con 1,17 millones, Polonia y Letonia con 0,80 millones cada una, y Bulgaria con 0,65 millones. Las exportaciones de cebada de la UE alcanzaron 1,97 millones de toneladas, un aumento respecto a los 1,91 millones de toneladas de la semana anterior, pero un descenso del 44% en términos interanuales. La Comisión señaló que los datos de exportación estaban incompletos en el caso de Francia desde principios de 2024, de Bulgaria e Irlanda desde el inicio de la campaña de comercialización 2023/24, y de Grecia desde enero de 2026.

item.title: La AIE decidirá la próxima semana los detalles de la liberación de reservas de diésel
item.description: El regulador energético de Occidente se reunirá la próxima semana para ultimar los detalles de una liberación de reservas de diésel, ante la creciente confusión en los mercados sobre cuántos barriles tienen previsto poner a disposición Europa y Estados Unidos para hacer frente a la escasez y a los precios récord, indicaron algunas fuentes.
item.dc:creator: Giuseppe Fonte, Kate Abnett, Alex Lawler
item.content:encoded: El regulador energético de Occidente se reunirá la próxima semana para ultimar los detalles de una liberación de reservas de diésel, ante la creciente confusión en los mercados sobre cuántos barriles tienen previsto poner a disposición Europa y Estados Unidos para hacer frente a la escasez y a los precios récord, indicaron algunas fuentes. Bajo la presión del presidente de Estados Unidos, Donald Trump, el Grupo de las Siete principales economías acordó el viernes liberar 100 millones de barriles de diésel y petróleo de las reservas de emergencia y se comprometió a abstenerse de imponer restricciones a la exportación de energía. Sin embargo, no facilitaron un desglose de los volúmenes de crudo, diésel y otros productos que se liberarán, ni indicaron qué países participarían. Se espera que el consejo de administración de la Agencia Internacional de la Energía (AIE), que asesora a los países industrializados y gestiona sus reservas estratégicas de petróleo, decida los detalles de la liberación de las reservas en una reunión del consejo que se celebrará los días 14 y 15 de octubre, dijeron el martes dos personas cercanas al asunto. La AIE no respondió de inmediato a una solicitud de comentarios sobre lo que se esperaba que se decidiera en la reunión del consejo. El G7 incluye a Estados Unidos, el Reino Unido, Japón y Canadá, junto con los países de la UE Francia, Alemania e Italia. Una de las fuentes dijo que Italia, miembro del G7, participaría en la liberación de reservas. El grupo de coordinación petrolera de la UE se reunirá el miércoles, informó el martes un portavoz de la Comisión Europea. La Casa Blanca no respondió de inmediato a una solicitud para aclarar los detalles de la liberación de reservas. La guerra de Irán desencadenó en marzo la mayor liberación de reservas de emergencia de la historia, de 400 millones de barriles, coordinada por la AIE. Al anunciar la nueva liberación de reservas, los líderes del G7 dijeron el pasado viernes que tendrían en cuenta los compromisos ya cumplidos en relación con la medida anterior. Los participantes en el mercado del petróleo y algunos responsables gubernamentales de la UE intentaban el martes perfilar los detalles del anuncio del viernes. Russell Hardy, director ejecutivo de Vitol, dijo el martes en una conferencia en Londres que la empresa de comercio de materias primas aún estaba tratando de comprender los detalles de la liberación de reservas. "No fue un anuncio del todo transparente sobre qué se iba a liberar exactamente y dónde", señaló. "Así pues, durante las próximas dos semanas, veremos cómo se publican licitaciones de diferentes organismos, y esas licitaciones nos indicarán exactamente cuánto petróleo se va a liberar y en qué lugar".

item.title: Commissione Ue propone misure contro derive antidemocratiche nuovi Stati membri
item.description: La Commissione europea ha presentato oggi un pacchetto di misure volte a preparare l'Unione all'allargamento, in vista dell'adesione di Paesi come Montenegro, Albania, Ucraina e Moldavia, cercando allo stesso tempo di rassicurare gli Stati membri sui potenziali costi politici ed economici.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: La Commissione europea ha presentato oggi un pacchetto di misure volte a preparare l'Unione all'allargamento, in vista dell'adesione di Paesi come Montenegro, Albania, Ucraina e Moldavia, cercando allo stesso tempo di rassicurare gli Stati membri sui potenziali costi politici ed economici. Le misure riflettono il rinnovato interesse degli Stati membri verso un ampliamento del blocco dei 27, alimentato in larga parte dall'invasione russa dell'Ucraina nel 2022 e dalla volontà di Kiev di entrare nell'Unione come parte di un accordo di pace. Le riforme proposte comprendono un meccanismo che consentirebbe agli altri Paesi dell'Ue di sospendere i diritti di voto di un nuovo Stato membro nei primi 15 anni di adesione, qualora questo si discosti dai valori dell'Unione, oltre a un piano per contenere il sostegno finanziario al vasto settore agricolo dell'Ucraina.

item.title: Senegal aims for deal with official creditors, bondholders by December, sources say
item.description: Senegal is aiming for an agreement in principle with its official lenders and bondholders by December, three sources said on Tuesday, two years after the emergence of misreported debt that analysts estimate totals $13 billion.
item.dc:creator: Portia Crowe, Libby George
item.content:encoded: Senegal is aiming for an agreement in principle with its official lenders and bondholders by December, three sources said on Tuesday, two years after the emergence of misreported debt that analysts estimate totals $13 billion. The West African country, which said last month it would seek debt "treatment" under the G20's Common Framework, made the comments during its first call with investors to outline its debt treatment plans, the sources told Reuters. It also said it would seek a "constructive contribution" from the 1 trillion CFA francs ($1.72 billion) outstanding in total return swaps (TRS). The closely watched TRS, derivative contracts that Senegal used to raise financing which are backed by CFA franc government securities, are [USN:L8N45710Y TEXT:"largely untested"] in restructurings. A government presentation named three counterparties, First Abu Dhabi Bank, Africa Finance Corporation and Société Générale for its TRS instruments, the sources said. ($1 = 581.0000 CFA francs)

item.title: S&P 500 e Nasdaq toccano nuovi massimi con calo rendimenti Treasury e greggio
item.description: L'S&P 500 e il Nasdaq toccano livelli record, grazie al ritracciamento dei rendimenti dei titoli del Tesoro dai massimi pluriennali e alla flessione dei prezzi del greggio, mentre gli investitori guardano alla prossima stagione delle trimestrali.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: L'S&P 500 e il Nasdaq toccano livelli record, grazie al ritracciamento dei rendimenti dei titoli del Tesoro dai massimi pluriennali e alla flessione dei prezzi del greggio, mentre gli investitori guardano alla prossima stagione delle trimestrali. ** La maggior parte delle “Magnifiche Sette” avanzano nelle prime fasi di negoziazione, con META (META.O) , TESLA (TSLA.O) e AMAZON.COM (AMZN.O) tutte in rialzo. ALPHABET (GOOGL.O) fa eccezione, in calo dello 0,27%. ** Il produttore di chip NVIDIA (NVDA.O) guadagna l’1,36%, portando la capitalizzazione di mercato vicino alla soglia dei 6.000 miliardi di dollari. ** Il rendimento del Treasury a 30 anni si mantiene stabile al 5,66%, mentre quello a 10 anni scende di 2,1 punti base al 5,28%. ** Sono attesi per oggi interventi pubblici di almeno quattro rappresentati della Fed, tra cui il presidente della Fed di New York John Williams. ** Alle 16.20 ore italiane, l’indice Dow Jones Industrial Average (.DJI) sale dello 0,60%, l’S&P 500 (.SPX) guadagna lo 0,71% e il Nasdaq Composite (.IXIC) guadagna lo 0,72%. ** Nel frattempo il greggio perde quasi il 2%, dopo che la tenuta delle esportazioni di greggio dal Medio Oriente e il rilascio delle riserve strategiche del G7 hanno attenuato le preoccupazioni sull'offerta. I titoli energetici dell'S&P 500 (.SPNY) cedono lo 0,6% ** Il produttore di chip AMD (AMD.O) avanza del 2,35% dopo che la Ceo Lisa Su ha detto che la società intende aumentare in modo sostanziale l’offerta di chip nel 2027 per soddisfare la domanda in forte espansione nel settore dell’IA. ** CONSTELLATION ENERGY (CEG.O) è la società che registra la migliore performance nell’indice S&P 500, in crescita del 12,54% dopo che Google ha siglato con l'azienda un accordo per la fornitura di energia da 3.590 megawatt.

item.title: Paramount conclude mega fusione con Warner Bros: nasce colosso Skydance
item.description: Paramount Skydance ha portato a termine l'acquisizione da 110 miliardi di dollari di Warner Bros Discovery , creando un colosso denominato Skydance e affidando al Ceo David Ellison il controllo di una delle maggiori società di intrattenimento al mondo.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Paramount Skydance ha portato a termine l'acquisizione da 110 miliardi di dollari di Warner Bros Discovery (WBD.O) , creando un colosso denominato Skydance e affidando al Ceo David Ellison il controllo di una delle maggiori società di intrattenimento al mondo. L’operazione riunisce gli studios che hanno prodotto 'Mission: Impossible', 'Harry Potter' e DC Studios insieme a importanti reti televisive e di streaming quali Cbs, Cnn, Paramount+ e Hbo Max, dando vita a una vasta società di intrattenimento che abbraccia cinema, televisione e informazione. Oggi le azioni della società risultante dalla fusione sono state trasferite dal Nasdaq al New York Stock Exchange, dove vengono scambiate con il ticker 'SKYD'.

item.title: GB pronta a espellere diplomatici israeliani se consolato Gerusalemme chiude
item.description: Di seguito gli aggiornamenti sulla situazione in Medio Oriente:
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Di seguito gli aggiornamenti sulla situazione in Medio Oriente: 15.20 - La Gran Bretagna potrebbe espellere diplomatici israeliani se Israele darà seguito all’ordine di chiudere il consolato britannico a Gerusalemme Est questa settimana, nell’ambito di una controversia sulle sanzioni contro gli insediamenti israeliani, secondo quanto riferito da quattro fonti. L'8 settembre Israele ha ordinato alla Gran Bretagna di chiudere il consolato di Gerusalemme Est entro 30 giorni e di ritirare i propri diplomatici dalla città, dopo che Londra aveva annunciato l'intenzione di imporre un divieto al commercio di beni prodotti negli insediamenti israeliani nella Cisgiordania occupata. Il termine di 30 giorni concesso alla Gran Bretagna per chiudere il consolato scade giovedì e ciò avrà ripercussioni su circa 30 diplomatici britannici che vi lavorano, insieme ai loro familiari, hanno detto le fonti. Se il consolato verrà chiuso, la Gran Bretagna risponderà probabilmente espellendo un numero analogo di diplomatici israeliani dall’ambasciata di Israele nel Regno Unito, hanno riferito le fonti, che hanno parlato a condizione di anonimato. 11.40 - Il petrolio pompato attraverso l'oleodotto Est-Ovest, che collega l'Arabia Saudita al centro di esportazione di Yanbu, sul Mar Rosso, ha raggiunto 5,8 milioni di barili nella mattinata odierna. Lo ha detto il ministro dell'Energia saudita, il principe Abdulaziz bin Salman. Il flusso di petrolio attraverso l'oleodotto Est-Ovest dell'Arabia Saudita non è stato interrotto, ha riferito ieri una fonte a Reuters, dopo indiscrezioni dei media su una recente interruzione della fornitura e in un contesto di ostilità tra l'Arabia Saudita e gli Houthi yemeniti. 9.45 - L'aeroporto internazionale Re Abdullah bin Abdulaziz di Jazan e l'aeroporto internazionale di Najran in Arabia Saudita sono stati oggetto di due attacchi ieri sera, che hanno causato tre feriti lievi e danni materiali limitati, mentre si intensificano le ostilità tra il Regno e gli Houthi yemeniti.

item.title: CON O ¿Qué sabemos sobre la muerte de una trabajadora del laboratorio del Instituto de la Peste en Rusia?
item.description: Una trabajadora de laboratorio de un instituto de investigación sobre la peste en Siberia enfermó y falleció en circunstancias no reveladas el 2 de octubre, lo que llevó a las autoridades a poner en cuarentena a unas 200 personas y provocó temores por la salud pública en las redes sociales.
item.dc:creator: Andrew Osborn, Jennifer Rigby
item.content:encoded: Una trabajadora de laboratorio de un instituto de investigación sobre la peste en Siberia enfermó y falleció en circunstancias no reveladas el 2 de octubre, lo que llevó a las autoridades a poner en cuarentena a unas 200 personas y provocó temores por la salud pública en las redes sociales. Esto es lo que sabemos sobre el caso —que las autoridades no han relacionado con su trabajo ni con la peste— y sobre la enfermedad que ella estudiaba. ¿QUÉ HA OCURRIDO? Los medios rusos identificaron a la víctima como Darya Shipilova, una trabajadora de laboratorio de 28 años del Instituto de Investigación contra la Peste de Irkutsk, en Siberia y el Lejano Oriente. Las autoridades dijeron que falleció a causa de un tipo desconocido de neumonía, pero que, como medida de precaución, pusieron en cuarentena a todas las personas que habían estado en contacto con ella. En las redes sociales han circulado informes no confirmados sobre cómo enfermó. Una versión dice que se le cayó un tubo de ensayo que contenía bacterias vivas en el trabajo, una teoría rechazada por la autoridad sanitaria rusa. Otra señala que enfermó tras viajar a Tailandia. Una tercera sostiene que enfermó tras visitar una zona cercana a la frontera con Mongolia. No hay pruebas de dominio público que respalden ninguna de esas teorías. ¿FALLECIÓ A CAUSA DE LA PESTE? No hay confirmación de que muriera de peste, aunque un gobernador regional afirmó que "podría" haber fallecido a causa de esta enfermedad. El organismo de control sanitario Rospotrebnadzor dijo que falleció a causa de un tipo desconocido de neumonía y que no se habían detectado patógenos relevantes en ninguna de las personas que habían estado en contacto con ella. ¿QUÉ ES LA PESTE Y SE PUEDE TRATAR? La peste circula principalmente entre pequeños animales y pulgas. Provocada por la bacteria Yersinia pestis, también puede infectar a los seres humanos. Entre los brotes destaca la "Peste Negra", que mató a más de 50 millones de personas en Europa en el siglo XIV. Se transmite entre animales y seres humanos a través de la picadura de pulgas infectadas, la inhalación de partículas respiratorias infectadas y —en raras ocasiones— la ingestión de materiales infecciosos. La tasa de mortalidad de la enfermedad oscila entre el 30% y 100% si no se trata. Si se detecta a tiempo, la peste puede tratarse con antibióticos. ¿ES FRECUENTE LA PESTE? La peste es endémica en muchos países africanos, la antigua Unión Soviética, América y Asia, pero la mayoría de los casos en humanos de los últimos seis años se han registrado en la República Democrática del Congo y Madagascar, según la Organización Mundial de la Salud. La peste es endémica en Siberia, lugar donde se produjo el primer brote humano prehistórico conocido, ya que la Yersinia pestis está presente allí entre pequeños mamíferos salvajes y sus pulgas. Es poco frecuente que los rusos contraigan la peste. ¿QUÉ ES EL INSTITUTO DE LA PESTE DE SIBERIA? El Instituto de Investigación contra la Peste de Irkutsk, en Siberia y el Lejano Oriente, se fundó en 1934 para controlar los brotes de peste. Según su página web, el científico que lo fundó ayudó a sofocar brotes en Siberia, Mongolia y China. Posteriormente, trabajó con otras enfermedades peligrosas, como el cólera y el ántrax. ¿QUÉ TIPOS DE PESTE EXISTEN? La peste se presenta en tres formas que afectan a diferentes partes del cuerpo. La peste neumónica, la forma más virulenta y menos común, es una infección de los pulmones que hace que los pacientes expulsen gotículas infecciosas a través de la tos. La peste bubónica es la forma más común; se produce principalmente cuando una pulga infectada pica a una persona y provoca la inflamación de los ganglios linfáticos o "bubones". La peste septicémica, que no se transmite de persona a persona, se produce cuando las bacterias de la peste se multiplican en la sangre. Una forma de peste puede derivar en otra. Las personas infectadas suelen presentar inicialmente síntomas similares a los de la gripe tras un periodo de incubación de entre uno y siete días. Sufren fiebre, escalofríos, dolores de cabeza y corporales, debilidad, vómitos y náuseas.

item.title: Aie deciderà dettagli rilascio scorte G7 di gasolio e greggio 14 e 15 ottobre - fonti
item.description: Il consiglio direttivo dell’Agenzia internazionale per l’energia (Aie) dovrebbe decidere, nel corso di una riunione in programma il 14 e 15 ottobre, i dettagli del rilascio delle scorte di gasolio e greggio annunciato dal Gruppo dei Sette la scorsa settimana, secondo quanto riferito da due fonti vicine alla questione.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Il consiglio direttivo dell’Agenzia internazionale per l’energia (Aie) dovrebbe decidere, nel corso di una riunione in programma il 14 e 15 ottobre, i dettagli del rilascio delle scorte di gasolio e greggio annunciato dal Gruppo dei Sette la scorsa settimana, secondo quanto riferito da due fonti vicine alla questione. Venerdì i Paesi del G7 hanno approvato il rilascio di 100 milioni di barili di gasolio e greggio dalle riserve di emergenza e si sono impegnati ad astenersi dall'imporre restrizioni alle esportazioni energetiche, a seguito delle pressioni esercitate dal presidente Usa Donald Trump. Tuttavia, non hanno fornito una ripartizione dei volumi di greggio, gasolio e altri prodotti da immettere sul mercato, né hanno specificato quali Paesi parteciperanno. Una fonte ha riferito che l’Italia, Paese membro del G7, aderirà al rilascio. Non è stato possibile avere un commento immediato dall'Aie.

item.title: Evasione fiscale in Italia oltre attese e in aumento - relazione Mef
item.description: L’evasione fiscale in Italia è più elevata di quanto stimato in precedenza e sta aumentando. Lo evidenziano nuovi dati del governo, che sollevano dubbi sulla capacità di Roma di gestire un problema cronico mentre cerca di tenere sotto controllo i conti pubblici.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: L’evasione fiscale in Italia è più elevata di quanto stimato in precedenza e sta aumentando. Lo evidenziano nuovi dati del governo, che sollevano dubbi sulla capacità di Roma di gestire un problema cronico mentre cerca di tenere sotto controllo i conti pubblici. Secondo la 'Relazione sull'economia non osservata e sull'evasione fiscale e contributiva' pubblicata da una commissione nominata dal ministero dell’Economia e delle Finanze, nel 2023 le imposte e i contributi sociali non versati sono aumentati di oltre 7 miliardi di euro rispetto al 2022, portando il totale a una cifra compresa tra 107,9 e 112,8 miliardi di euro. L’Italia pubblica le stime sull’evasione fiscale con un ritardo di tre anni, in modo che, qualora si riscontrasse una diminuzione dell’evasione, i governi non possano spendere entrate che potrebbero rivelarsi temporanee. Con un debito pubblico ingente e in crescita, che dovrebbe toccare un picco del 138,5% del Pil il prossimo anno, Roma punta a perseguire una politica di bilancio prudente in un contesto di aumento del costo del denaro. COLLABORAZIONE INVECE CHE REPRESSIONE Da quando è entrata in carica nel 2022, la premier Giorgia Meloni ha adottato quello che definisce un approccio collaborativo nei confronti dei contribuenti, sostenendo che le precedenti misure repressive contro gli evasori non avevano funzionato. La sua prima manovra di bilancio ha offerto ai trasgressori 12 diverse sanatorie fiscali, riducendo o azzerando le sanzioni per chi avesse saldato i propri debiti con il fisco. La relazione ha evidenziato che l’evasione fiscale è cresciuta tra il 2021 e il 2023, pur aggiungendo che l’incremento in termini assoluti potrebbe in parte riflettere un reddito imponibile più elevato, trainato dalla ripresa economica post Covid-19 e dall’aumento dell’inflazione negli ultimi anni. Gli esperti nominati dal governo hanno quindi raccomandato di utilizzare come parametro di analisi il rapporto tra l’ammontare delle imposte non pagate e il totale delle imposte dovute. Utilizzando questo criterio, la propensione all’evasione fiscale in Italia è scesa su base annua di 0,2 punti percentuali nel 2023, attestandosi a un valore stimato tra il 17,3% e il 17,5%. Tra il 2019 e il 2023 l’indicatore ha registrato un miglioramento più marcato, di circa 2,5 punti percentuali. La propensione a evadere l’imposta sul valore aggiunto è salita al 20,4% nel 2023 dal 19,4% dell’anno precedente. "In una prospettiva di più lungo periodo emerge, tuttavia, una progressiva riduzione del peso del sommerso sull’economia nazionale", si legge nella relazione. D'altra parte, l’Italia ha rivisto al rialzo le stime relative alle imposte e ai contributi previdenziali non versati per il periodo 2019-2022 rispetto ai dati pubblicati nella precedente relazione diffusa un anno fa. Tra le misure volte ad allentare la precedente stretta sull'evasione, Meloni ha innalzato il tetto ai pagamenti in contanti da 1.000 a 5.000 euro. È stata costretta a fare marcia indietro su una proposta volta a ridurre le sanzioni per i commercianti che rifiutano di accettare pagamenti digitali, a seguito delle critiche mosse dalle autorità dell’Unione europea.

item.title: Iran drone plot fears led US to remove bombers from UK base, US officials say
item.description: A suspected plot involving Iran to launch a complex drone attack on a key British airbase led the United States to remove its B-1 bomber aircraft from the base, two US officials told Reuters on Tuesday, speaking on condition of anonymity.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: A suspected plot involving Iran to launch a complex drone attack on a key British airbase led the United States to remove its B-1 bomber aircraft from the base, two US officials told Reuters on Tuesday, speaking on condition of anonymity. Iran has denied any involvement in any alleged plot at RAF Fairford, the preferred European base for US bombers. British police said on Tuesday they had arrested a 22-year-old British man in London on suspicion of preparation of terrorist acts as part of their investigation into the [USN:L1N45R04X TEXT:"suspected plot"]. A spokesperson for the US military's European Command declined to comment, saying: "It is inappropriate to discuss matters of intelligence, and we will not discuss specific force protection measures." "As demonstrated across multiple operations, America's bombers, including B-1s, B-2s, and B-52s — can deliver precision global strike capabilities – including through operations that launch and recover from the continental United States – anywhere, anytime," the spokesperson said.

item.title: パラマウント、1100億ドルのワーナー買収完了 新会社「スカイダンス」誕生
item.description:
Anzar Mehraj Harshita Mary Varghese
[６日 ロイター] - 米メディア大手パラマウ...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
パラマウント、1100億ドルのワーナー買収完了　新会社「スカイダンス」誕生 10/6 23:48 配信

米カリフォルニア州ロサンゼルスのパラマウント・スタジオで９月撮影。REUTERS/Daniel Cole

Anzar Mehraj　Harshita Mary Varghese

[６日　ロイター] - 米メディア大手パラマウント・スカイダンスは６日、ワーナー・ブラザース・ディスカバリー（ＷＢＤ）を買収する１１００億ドル規模の大型取引が完了したと発表した。これにより、新会社「スカイダンス」が誕生し、デービッド・エリソン最高経営責任者（ＣＥＯ）が世界最大級のエンターテインメント企業を率いることになる。

統合後の新会社「スカイダンス」の株式は６日、ナスダックからニューヨーク証券取引所に移管され、「SKYD」のティッカーシンボルで取引が開始された。

人気映画シリーズ「ミッション：インポッシブル」や「ハリー・ポッター」などを手がけるスタジオに、ＣＢＳニュース、ＣＮＮニュース、「パラマウント＋（プラス）」、「ＨＢＯマックス」などの主要なテレビや動画配信サービスが統合され、映画、テレビ、ニュースを網羅する広範なエンターテインメント企業が誕生する。

ただ、新会社は約８００億ドルの負債を抱える見通しで、エリソン氏には配信事業の拡大、ケーブルネットワーク事業からのキャッシュフロー維持、劇場公開映画の業績改善が求められる。

調査会社モフェットナサンソンのアナリストは、同社の２０２８年の利払い・税引き・償却前利益（ＥＢＩＴＤＡ）を１６０億ドル、３０年には１９０億ドルに増加すると予想。売上高は２８年に約６７０億ドル、３０年には約７００億ドルに達すると見込む。

スカイダンスは、買収完了後の最初の２年間は年間少なくとも３０本、その後の３年間は年間３２本の映画を製作すると公約している。

エリソン氏は先週、統合後の新会社名を「スカイダンス」とした理由について、パラマウントとワーナー・ブラザースの両映画スタジオの個別のアイデンティティーが失われないようにすることが目的で、新たな企業ブランドの下に統合するものではないと説明していた。

ロイター 関連ニュース コラム：武田薬のシャイアー買収5年、大型Ｍ＆Ａの難しさ示す コラム：ＡＩブームの恩恵受ける小型テック株、先行きは不透明 アングル：米株式取引24時間化、ウォール街では期待と慎重論が交錯 アングル：米株のテック依存、「ＩＴバブル期」上回る　市場を不安定に 焦点：過熱するＡＩ相場、収益化への懸念で市場に警戒感も 最終更新: 10/6(火) 23:48 ロイター

item.title: Fed plans to overhaul bank supervision responsibilities, Bowman says
item.description: The Federal Reserve plans to overhaul how it supervises US banks, replacing a model that charged its regional bank presidents with overseeing examinations with a new one that will be more accountable to Washington, the central bank's top regulatory official said on Tuesday.
item.dc:creator: Pete Schroeder
item.content:encoded: The Federal Reserve plans to overhaul how it supervises US banks, replacing a model that charged its regional bank presidents with overseeing examinations with a new one that will be more accountable to Washington, the central bank's top regulatory official said on Tuesday. Fed Vice Chair for Supervision Michelle Bowman said the restructuring will create five new geographic regions for bank supervision, with each led by a "regional leader." Currently, Fed leaders in Washington set bank examination policy, but the actual supervision is conducted and overseen by the 12 regional Fed banks across the country. In prepared remarks for a conference at the St. Louis Fed, Bowman argued that the existing structure "disincentivized a critical link between responsibility and accountability," pointing to [USN:L6N45916U TEXT:"an independent review"] of the collapse of Silicon Valley Bank, which she commissioned. It found that Fed examiners were slow to take action. "The Federal Reserve supervisory function will be realigned to implement a culture of accountability and clear decisionmaking authority," Bowman said. Under the new arrangement, new regional leaders will be charged with all supervisory activity, which will still be conducted by regional Reserve Bank staff. Currently, regional Fed presidents are charged with monitoring supervision in each of their districts. Bowman also criticized the heavy use of various committees by the Fed in conducting bank supervision, which she argued created delays and muddied responsibilities among central bank staff when problems emerged at banks, and she argued their use should be streamlined. "In practice, these committees became a source for plausible deniability and a disincentive for examiners to take prompt and decisive action to address identified risks," she said. UPDATED ASSET THRESHOLDS Bowman has embarked on a massive overhaul of how the central bank oversees the nation's largest and most complex banks. Since taking the head regulatory role at the Fed in 2025, she has replaced supervisory leaders, [USN:L1N3WB1JK TEXT:"trimmed staff"] and issued new guidelines streamlining what issues examiners should probe and how they ding institutions for shortcomings. Bowman has argued that examiners should focus primarily on material financial risks at banks, and that examiners have gotten distracted over the years by minor procedural shortfalls. She also announced on Tuesday that the Fed later this year would consider updating asset thresholds that determine when banks should face stricter rules. Reuters [USN:L1N45H0ES TEXT:"reported in September"] that the central bank was working on such a plan, which could give banks more room to grow before triggering new rules on capital, liquidity and stress testing. As part of that effort, Bowman said the Fed would consider updates to fixed-dollar asset thresholds, as well as a mechanism that would update them every five years to account for inflation and economic growth. Banks have complained for years that fixed asset levels can become outdated and result in stricter rules being applied to firms that were not originally the target of such oversight.

item.title: UEFA did not say it stripped Manchester City of its Champions League title
item.description: A screenshot of UEFA’s president delivering a speech five years ago has been republished by online posts suggesting it supports a false narrative that he announced stripping Manchester City of its 2022-23 Champions League title last week over the results of a Premier League investigation.
item.dc:creator: Reuters Fact Check
item.content:encoded: A screenshot of UEFA’s president delivering a speech five years ago has been republished by online posts suggesting it supports a false narrative that he announced stripping Manchester City of its 2022-23 Champions League title last week over the results of a Premier League investigation . Here are the key details: Online posts published the claim on September 29 after the Premier League announced that an independent commission ruling found Manchester City guilty of serious breaches of the league’s financial rules. A UEFA spokesperson told Reuters that the online claim was inaccurate. UEFA’s website lists Manchester City as the 2022-23 winners as of October 6. The screenshot in the posts shows UEFA president Aleksander Ceferin giving a speech in April 2021 when he criticised a proposal made at the time for a [USN:L1N2MC0IE TEXT:"breakaway European Super League"]. Manchester City did not immediately respond to a request for comment. The club has denied wrongdoing throughout the Premier League investigation process and has [USN:L6N45O0MF TEXT:"filed an appeal"] against the commission ruling. Verdict: False. UEFA says the claim is inaccurate, and the screenshot shows UEFA’s president giving an unrelated speech in 2021. This article was produced by the Reuters Fact Check team. Read more about our fact-checking work.

item.title: Rússia diz que não foram detectados casos de peste na Sibéria; população local minimiza temor
item.description: A agência reguladora de saúde da Rússia informou nesta terça-feira que não foram detectados casos de peste entre as pessoas que tiveram contato com uma funcionária do laboratório do Instituto Siberiano de Pesquisa da Peste que morreu na semana passada, e os moradores locais disseram que suas vidas quase não foram afetadas.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: A agência reguladora de saúde da Rússia informou nesta terça-feira que não foram detectados casos de peste entre as pessoas que tiveram contato com uma funcionária do laboratório do Instituto Siberiano de Pesquisa da Peste que morreu na semana passada, e os moradores locais disseram que suas vidas quase não foram afetadas. As autoridades afirmam que a mulher de 28 anos faleceu na sexta-feira devido a uma pneumonia de origem ainda não determinada, em um caso que gerou preocupação internacional, inclusive por parte do presidente dos EUA, Donald Trump. O Rospotrebnadzor, órgão regulador, afirmou em comunicado que nenhuma doença infecciosa foi relatada entre os funcionários do mesmo instituto de pesquisa sobre a peste em Irkutsk nos últimos 10 dias e que exames extensivos não encontraram, no corpo da falecida, nenhum microrganismo relacionado ao seu trabalho. “Um conjunto abrangente de medidas antiepidêmicas foi imediatamente organizado e implementado integralmente, de acordo com a legislação de saúde pública”, afirmou o órgão regulador. “Isso incluiu identificar o maior número possível de pessoas que tiveram contato com a paciente e providenciar para que fossem colocadas em observação médica no hospital, com exames laboratoriais diários.” Segundo o órgão, os resultados revelaram dois casos de Covid-19 e dois casos de infecção por rinovírus, mas nenhum patógeno causador de outras doenças infecciosas foi detectado. “Nenhum dos contatos apresentou alterações no estado de saúde associadas a doenças infecciosas”, acrescentou. Elena Sofina, vice-chefe do distrito de Shelekhov, próximo a Irkutsk, onde um hospital local foi colocado em quarentena, disse que o que ela chamou de “diagnóstico perigoso” não havia sido confirmado. Ela acrescentou que 60% das pessoas colocadas em quarentena por precaução já haviam sido liberadas. A mídia local informou que cerca de 200 pessoas foram colocadas em quarentena anteriormente. OFERTA DE AJUDA DE TRUMP O porta-voz do Kremlin, Dmitry Peskov, expressou gratidão pela oferta de ajuda feita na segunda-feira por Trump, embora sem deixar claro se Moscou planeja aceitá-la. “É sempre bom quando se oferece assistência mútua”, disse Peskov aos repórteres. Trump descreveu na segunda-feira a situação como um “grande problema para a Rússia”. O secretário de Estado dos EUA, Marco Rubio, afirmou na terça-feira que cabia a Moscou compartilhar mais informações. A Organização Mundial da Saúde, em Genebra, disse na terça-feira que a Rússia comunicou que não havia casos de peste na cidade de Irkutsk. A Reuters não conseguiu determinar imediatamente se isso significava que a peste poderia ser descartada no caso da funcionária do laboratório. Na cidade de Shelekhov, onde a funcionária do laboratório teria falecido no hospital, moradores locais disseram que suas vidas quase não foram afetadas, embora tenham mencionado que algumas pessoas nas lojas tenham usado inicialmente máscaras cirúrgicas como precaução. Uma moradora que se identificou apenas como Anna disse que a situação estava tranquila e que as pessoas estavam preparadas para a introdução de restrições, mas que a vida continuava praticamente como de costume. “Todos tinham máscaras em casa e as usaram por não mais do que 24 horas”, declarou ela à Reuters. Denis, outro morador, disse que a notícia da morte da funcionária do laboratório havia sido amplamente comentada na cidade e que o hospital local chegou a suspender temporariamente a realização de exames diagnósticos, mas já havia retomado suas atividades normais.

item.title: S&P 500, Nasdaq alcanzan máximos ante descenso de rendimientos de bonos y del petróleo
item.description: El índice de referencia S&P 500 y el Nasdaq alcanzaron máximos históricos el martes, tras una baja de los rendimientos de los bonos del Tesoro desde sus máximos de varios años y una caída de los precios del petróleo, mientras los inversores esperaban con interés la próxima temporada de resultados trimestrales.
item.dc:creator: Tharuniyaa Lakshmi, Shashwat Chauhan
item.content:encoded: El índice de referencia S&P 500 y el Nasdaq alcanzaron máximos históricos el martes, tras una baja de los rendimientos de los bonos del Tesoro desde sus máximos de varios años y una caída de los precios del petróleo, mientras los inversores esperaban con interés la próxima temporada de resultados trimestrales. La mayoría de las acciones de las "Siete Magníficas" subían ligeramente en las primeras horas de negociación: Meta (META.O) , Tesla (TSLA.O) y Amazon.com (AMZN.O) anotaban ganancias. Apple (AAPL.O) y Alphabet (GOOGL.O) eran las excepciones, con caídas de alrededor del 0,2% cada una. El fabricante de chips Nvidia (NVDA.O) subía un 1,2%, lo que situaba la capitalización bursátil de la empresa más valiosa del mundo cerca de la barrera de los 6 billones de dólares. "El sector que, en mi opinión, se considera que va a obtener mejores resultados es el de las tecnologías de la información", dijo Robert Pavlik, gestor sénior de carteras de Dakota Wealth. "Las expectativas para el resto de sectores son bastante más bajas, salvo en el caso de la energía. El aumento de los precios de la energía va a tener un impacto negativo en el gasto de los consumidores". El optimismo en torno al sector de la inteligencia artificial y las esperanzas de unos sólidos resultados empresariales impulsaron las acciones tecnológicas, lo que reforzó aún más el mercado alcista que comenzó en octubre de 2022. El rendimiento de los bonos del Tesoro a 30 años se mantenía estable en el 5,66%, mientras que el del bono de referencia a 10 años caía 2,1 puntos básicos, al 5,28%. El reporte sobre el empleo de la semana pasada, más débil de lo esperado, atenuó las expectativas en torno a las subidas de tasas de interés este año. Los operadores ven ahora un 78% de probabilidad de que la Reserva Federal mantenga las tasas de interés sin cambios este mes, aunque una subida en diciembre sigue estando en gran medida descontada, según la herramienta FedWatch del CME Group. El martes, al menos cuatro responsables de la Fed, entre ellos el presidente de la Fed de Nueva York, John Williams, tienen previstos discursos públicos.

item.title: German group seeks to prevent role of Russia's Rosatom in nuclear project
item.description: German environmental organisation BUND said on Tuesday that it plans to ask a court to stop the planned expansion of a nuclear fuel plant that would allow cooperation with Russia's state nuclear corporation Rosatom.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: German environmental organisation BUND said on Tuesday that it plans to ask a court to stop the planned expansion of a nuclear fuel plant that would allow cooperation with Russia's state nuclear corporation Rosatom. BUND said it would seek an emergency injunction to prevent the project from proceeding while its [USN:L1N45306E TEXT:"lawsuit"] against Lower Saxony, the state that initially approved the expansion, is considered by the courts. The group said it had serious doubts about the legality of the environmental impact assessment underpinning the approval by the state. Anti-nuclear campaign group .ausgestrahlt, which is collaborating with BUND on the case, warned that Rosatom could establish a foothold in Germany before the courts reach a final decision. Located in northwestern Germany, the Lingen fuel plant is one of the country's last remaining facilities linked to the nuclear fuel cycle. The case could become a test of Berlin's willingness and ability to keep Russian state-backed companies out of strategically sensitive parts of its energy sector. Germany's federal environment ministry reiterated its opposition to cooperation with Rosatom, but said the appropriate response would be EU sanctions on Russia's nuclear sector, for which there is currently not enough support among EU member states. Plant operator ANF, Rosatom and the state environment ministry did not immediately respond to requests for comment.

item.title: Belgian strike prompts flight cancellations at Brussels Airport on Friday
item.description: Several flights at Brussels Airport will be cancelled on Friday due to a nationwide strike, with staff at ground handling company Alyzia set to join the walkout, the airport said on Tuesday, without specifying the number of affected flights.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Several flights at Brussels Airport will be cancelled on Friday due to a nationwide strike, with staff at ground handling company Alyzia set to join the walkout, the airport said on Tuesday, without specifying the number of affected flights. Belgian media reported that at least 140 flights were expected to be cancelled. A spokesperson for the airport was not immediately available to confirm the number.

item.title: Mattel shares slip as investor urges strategic review
item.description: Mattel's shares fell about 3% on Tuesday after investor Ariel Investments urged the toymaker to explore strategic alternatives, including a sale, merger or major asset divestiture.
item.dc:creator: Neil Kanatt
item.content:encoded: Mattel's shares (MAT.O) fell about 3% on Tuesday after investor Ariel Investments urged the toymaker to explore strategic alternatives, including a sale, merger or major asset divestiture. The move adds to mounting pressure on Mattel, which last week announced [USN:L4N45N1PR TEXT:"the departure of chief executive Yvon Kreiz"], with the [USN:L4N45N1E2 TEXT:"company since"] attracting fresh takeover interest. Here are more details: Ariel, which owns a 5.4% stake, [USN:L4N45R1B2 TEXT:"said in a letter"] that Mattel's shares remain significantly undervalued and that its portfolio could appeal to other toy companies, entertainment companies and private equity firms. Last week, Authentic Brands, whose portfolio includes Reebok, Brooks Brothers and Guess, [USN:L4N45N1E2 TEXT:"approached"] Mattel about a potential acquisition valuing the company at about $6 billion or more, a source familiar with the matter told Reuters. This is the second time this year an investor has pushed for a strategic review. In May, investor Southeastern Asset Management urged the company to evaluate options including going private or pursuing a sale to Hasbro (HAS.O) or a media company. Mattel, which has faced pressure from weakening toy demand and higher tariff-related costs in recent years, said it would "consider the views expressed in Ariel Investments' letter" while "acting in the best interests of all shareholders." "The debate increasingly comes down to whether Mattel's brands are worth more inside Mattel or in someone else's hands. Investors will want evidence that the whole company is worth more than the sum of its parts," said Brian Jacobsen, Chief Economic Strategist, Annex Wealth Management. Mattel, which is currently trading at $15.65, has a forward price-to-earnings multiple of 10.45, compared with 14.35 for Hasbro, according to data compiled by LSEG.

item.title: Índia está entre sete países que disputam a sede das Olimpíadas de 2036, diz COI
item.description: Sete países, incluindo Índia, Alemanha e Catar, estão na disputa para sediar os Jogos Olímpicos de 2036, informou o Comitê Olímpico Internacional nesta terça-feira.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Sete países, incluindo Índia, Alemanha e Catar, estão na disputa para sediar os Jogos Olímpicos de 2036, informou o Comitê Olímpico Internacional nesta terça-feira. Hungria, Turquia, África do Sul e Coreia do Sul completam a lista de países interessados, que estão em negociações preliminares com o COI. Uma lista de finalistas será elaborada em março do ano que vem, e alguns países avançarão para uma fase de diálogo estratégico. “Onde quer que os Jogos ocorram, uma coisa nunca deve mudar: os atletas precisam estar no centro de tudo o que fazemos”, afirmou a presidente do COI, Kirsty Coventry. “É por isso que, para qualquer futuro anfitrião, proporcionar a melhor experiência possível aos atletas deve ser sempre o ponto de partida.” A Índia, país mais populoso do mundo, está tentando sediar suas primeiras Olimpíadas, enquanto o Catar, que já se candidatou anteriormente com Doha, está fazendo campanha para se tornar o primeiro país de maioria muçulmana a sediar o maior evento multiesportivo do mundo. O Catar sediou a Copa do Mundo de futebol de 2022. A Hungria, que mais recentemente se candidatou às Olimpíadas de 2024, nunca sediou os Jogos, enquanto Munique, sede das Olimpíadas de 1972, é a candidata da Alemanha. Istambul, na Turquia, fracassou em cinco tentativas anteriores, enquanto a África do Sul espera se tornar o primeiro país africano a sediar as Olimpíadas. A África do Sul tem experiência em grandes eventos, tendo organizado a Copa do Mundo de Futebol de 2010. A Coreia do Sul já sediou tanto as Olimpíadas de verão quanto as de inverno, em Seul, em 1988, e em Pyeongchang, em 2018. Os anfitriões preferidos serão indicados após a fase de diálogo em 2028, e a decisão final está prevista para meados de 2029. Quaisquer outros países interessados têm até 31 de outubro para se candidatar, mas é altamente improvável que surjam novos candidatos a menos de quatro semanas do prazo final.

item.title: New York Fed says supply chain pressures rose last month relative to August
item.description: Supply chain pressures heated up modestly in September, a report said from the Federal Reserve Bank of New York on Tuesday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Supply chain pressures heated up modestly in September, a report said from the Federal Reserve Bank of New York on Tuesday. The bank reported that its latest Global Supply Chain Pressure Index moved up to 1.28 in September versus the upwardly revised 1.20 seen in August. The release did not say what drove the recent performance of the index, which is designed to track how well global supply chains are functioning. While September’s pressure level rose, supply chain pressures have nevertheless retreated from their most recent peak of 1.81 in May, which while elevated, was far below the 4.43 reading hit in December 2021, which captured the widespread disruptions caused by the COVID-19 pandemic. Elevated supply chain pressures can be a contributor to rising inflation pressures. Fed officials raised their interest rate target last month and penciled in another increase for year end as part of a bid to help bring elevated price pressures back to the 2% target.

item.title: Google fights £1 billion UK lawsuit over app store fees in latest Big Tech case
item.description: Google was accused of abusing its dominance to levy excessive commissions on app developers, as a mass consumer lawsuit worth over £1 billion ($1.33 billion) began in London on Tuesday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Google (GOOGL.O) was accused of abusing its dominance to levy excessive commissions on app developers, as a mass consumer lawsuit worth over £1 billion ($1.33 billion) began in London on Tuesday. The case — brought on behalf of around 20 million consumers who bought apps through Google's Play Store, or paid for in-app purchases and subscriptions between 2015 and this July — is the latest brought in Britain against Big Tech. Lawyers representing consumer advocate Liz Coll, who is leading the claim, say Google used its dominant position to charge commissions of up to 30% on purchases of apps through its Play Store, as well as on in-app purchases and subscriptions. They argue that those excessive commissions were passed on by app developers to consumers, citing as an example that when Google sold YouTube Premium through Apple's App Store it also decided to pass on the commission it was charged. But Google's parent Alphabet is fighting the lawsuit, which a spokesperson said ignores the degree of choice the Android platform gives consumers and that it charges "some of the lowest fees in the market". The tech giant's lawyers, who said Coll's case was unfounded, argued the Play Store "faces strong competitive constraints both on the developer and consumer sides", including from Apple's App Store and other alternative platforms. The trial at London's Competition Appeal Tribunal follows similar cases against [USN:L8N3W41ZK TEXT:"Apple"] and [USN:L1N3ZW07V TEXT:"Sony"] over their App Store and PlayStation Store, both of which cited commissions of up to 30%. Coll's case also comes after years of [USN:L8N4320CJ TEXT:"regulatory scrutiny"] and litigation over Google's app store practices, including a long-running battle with "Fortnite" maker Epic Games, whose London lawsuit was due to be heard alongside Coll's. In March, Google and Epic reached a worldwide settlement under which Google said it would [USN:L4N3ZS1RJ TEXT:"expand billing options"] and cut developer fees. Last month, Google also [USN:L1N44O0TR TEXT:"settled"] another lawsuit for £260 million, which was brought on behalf of app developers, without making any admission of liability or wrongdoing. ($1 = 0.7536 pounds)

item.title: Influencia de fondos de cobertura en los mercados está aumentando, merece seguimiento más minucioso: FMI
item.description: Los fondos de cobertura han más que triplicado su tamaño en la última década y ahora desempeñan un papel cada vez más crucial en los mercados, afirmó el martes el Fondo Monetario Internacional, que advirtió de que el uso del apalancamiento y la opacidad general de estos fondos pueden generar riesgos en el sistema financiero.
item.dc:creator: Pete Schroeder
item.content:encoded: Los fondos de cobertura han más que triplicado su tamaño en la última década y ahora desempeñan un papel cada vez más crucial en los mercados, afirmó el martes el Fondo Monetario Internacional, que advirtió de que el uso del apalancamiento y la opacidad general de estos fondos pueden generar riesgos en el sistema financiero. El FMI publicó estas conclusiones al dar a conocer un capítulo de su Informe sobre la Estabilidad Financiera Mundial, que se publicará íntegramente el 13 de octubre. Esto es lo que ha constatado el organismo: Los fondos de cobertura están desempeñando un papel cada vez más destacado en la negociación, la liquidez y la transferencia de riesgos, ya que los activos de estos fondos ascienden actualmente a unos 13 billones de dólares a principios de 2026, lo que supone un aumento significativo respecto a los apenas 4 billones de dólares de 2013 El crecimiento de los fondos de cobertura se ha debido principalmente al apalancamiento, incluido el apalancamiento sintético a través de derivados Estos fondos han ampliado considerablemente su presencia en los mercados de deuda soberana, especialmente en los bonos del Tesoro de EEUU. Los fondos de cobertura representan ahora el 9% del mercado de bonos del Tesoro, frente a apenas el 4% en 2022 Si bien una mayor presencia de los fondos de cobertura puede impulsar la eficiencia del mercado, el FMI advirtió que también pueden amplificar las tensiones cuando los mercados se deterioran, sobre todo debido al uso del apalancamiento por parte de esas entidades y a las menores restricciones en materia de riesgo El FMI advirtió que los fondos de cobertura siguen siendo "intrínsecamente opacos", lo que dificulta evaluar con precisión sus riesgos y exposiciones. Instó a los responsables de política monetaria a subsanar las lagunas de datos y a reforzar la supervisión de los riesgos del sector ante posibles vulnerabilidades

item.title: Riesgo país de Argentina mantiene sesgo bajista por impulso de Brasil
item.description: El riesgo país de Argentina bajaba el martes por segundo ronda consecutiva, ante una mejora en los niveles de la deuda pública tras el optimismo regional que representó el triunfo de la derecha en las recientes elecciones de Brasil.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: El riesgo país de Argentina bajaba el martes por segundo ronda consecutiva, ante una mejora en los niveles de la deuda pública tras el optimismo regional que representó el triunfo de la derecha en las recientes elecciones de Brasil. El senador Flávio Bolsonaro se enfrentará al mandatario Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva en el balotaje de las elecciones presidenciales de [USN:L1N45R01Q TEXT:"Brasil"], después de que el aspirante de derecha obtuviera alrededor del 47% de los votos válidos en la primera vuelta del domingo, superando las previsiones de la mayoría de los sondeos. "A este resultado (en las urnas) no lo reflejaron la mayoría de las encuestas y por eso sorprendió, lo que aligeró el circulante de liquidez en toda la región. Pero hay que considerar que lo que puede ser bueno para los mercados, no necesariamente sea beneficioso para la marcha de la economía real", comentó un analista del Banco Galicia. La fuerte recuperación de los mercados financieros el lunes aún derramaba beneficios este martes, donde el riesgo país argentino elaborado por el J.P.Morgan caía a 575 puntos básicos (1420 GMT), desde las casi 600 unidades como cierre previo y desde los 655 puntos anotados el viernes último. El índice accionario S&P Merval (.MERV) de la bolsa de Buenos Aires ganaba un 0,6% por coberturas rápidas, contra un salto del 3,68% del lunes, mientras que los bonos soberanos promediaban un positivo 0,3%, desde la subida del 0,9% previa. "El índice de tipo de cambio real multilateral de Argentina tiene a Brasil como su principal componente, con una ponderación del 20%", resaltó Rava Bursátil. La firma acotó que "el secretario del Tesoro de Estados Unidos, Scott Bessent, afirmó que volvería a apoyar financieramente a la Argentina en caso de ser necesario. Además, el equipo económico argentino declaró tener 15.000 millones de dólares para vender en futuros con vencimiento en 2027". El peso mayorista apenas subía un leve 0,03% a 1.520 por dólar , con la intervención cotidiana del banco central (BCRA) mediante la absorción de divisas para respaldar sus reservas internacionales. Un reciente sondeo publicado por el portal Perfil indicó que siete de cada diez empresarios participantes del coloquio anual de IDEA creen que el peso está sobrevaluado, ya que el nivel actual debería superar las 1.800 unidades por dólar.

item.title: Turkey central bank governor says disinflation to regain pace, cautious stance to continue
item.description: Disinflation in Turkey is expected to regain momentum provided that supply pressures ease, Central Bank governor Fatih Karahan said on Tuesday, adding the bank would keep a cautious monetary policy to preserve gains achieved so far in lowering inflation.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Disinflation in Turkey is expected to regain momentum provided that supply pressures ease, Central Bank governor Fatih Karahan said on Tuesday, adding the bank would keep a cautious monetary policy to preserve gains achieved so far in lowering inflation. In a presentation to a parliamentary commission, Karahan said a slowdown in the disinflation process had been caused by war-related energy price volatility but that "the main trend in inflation remains below annual inflation", signaling that disinflation would continue if supply pressures fade. Here are some key points from his presentation: A slowdown in domestic demand has become marked, with indicators confirming a weakening of consumption activity. A slowdown in services inflation is continuing despite supply shocks, with weaker domestic demand also contributing. Leading indicators show that a slowdown in rent inflation is expected to continue. The current account deficit to GDP ratio in 2026 is seen below long-term averages. Upside risks to energy prices are being evaluated; tight policy is seen as important in limiting the inflationary impact of supply shocks. A weaker-than-expected improvement in inflation expectations poses a risk to the disinflation process.

item.title: ＩＭＦ、ヘッジファンドの存在感拡大 監視強化を要請
item.description:
Pete Schroeder
[ワシントン ６日 ロイター] - 国際通貨基金（ＩＭＦ）は６日、ヘッジファンドは過去１...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
ＩＭＦ、ヘッジファンドの存在感拡大　監視強化を要請 10/6 23:21 配信

米ワシントンにある国際通貨基金（IMF）本部前で2018年5月撮影。REUTERS/Yuri Gripas

Pete Schroeder

[ワシントン ６日 ロイター] - 国際通貨基金（ＩＭＦ）は６日、ヘッジファンドは過去１０年あまりで資産規模が３倍以上に拡大し、現在では市場においてますます重要な役割を担っていると指摘した。同時に、ファンドによるレバレッジの利用と全体的な不透明性が金融システムにリスクをもたらす可能性があると警告した。

ＩＭＦは６日、世界金融安定報告書の一部の公表にあわせ、この調査結果を発表した。報告書全文は１０月１３日に公表される。調査結果は以下のとおり。

• ヘッジファンドは、トレーディング、流動性、リスク移転においてますます重要な役割を担っており、ファンドの資産は２０１３年のわずか４兆ドルから２６年初頭には約１３兆ドルにまで大幅に増加している。

• ヘッジファンドの成長は主にレバレッジ、特にデリバティブを通じた合成レバレッジによってもたらされてきた。

• こうしたファンドは、特に米国債市場において、その存在感を著しく高めている。ヘッジファンドは現在、米国債市場の９％を占めており、２２年のわずか４％から大幅に増加している。

• ヘッジファンドの存在感が高まることで市場効率が向上する可能性がある一方で、特にこれらの企業がレバレッジを利用し、リスクに対する制約が少ないことから、市場が悪化した際にストレスを増幅させる可能性もある。

• ヘッジファンドは依然として「本質的に不透明」であり、リスクやエクスポージャーを正確に評価することが困難である。政策立案者は、データ不足を解消し、潜在的な脆弱性に対する同セクターのリスク監視を強化する必要がある。

ロイター 関連ニュース アングル：米政府、借り入れコスト抑制へ選択肢狭まる　歳出削減以外ならインフレ加速も コラム：米法律事務所、ロースクール1年生に採用攻勢　人材争奪戦が過熱 アングル：エヌビディア、ＡＩ半導体担保の巨大融資市場構想、資産価値巡りウォール街と溝 アングル：米株高支える高い増益、投資家は持続可能性に不安も コラム：米だけ「異世界」のＩＭＦ会合　イラン戦争無視で政権の苦境露呈 最終更新: 10/6(火) 23:21 ロイター

item.title: Bankers are sitting on a $4 trln rotten nest egg
item.description: Giving AI assistants like Meta's Muse full dominion over their cash might go too far for most people. But savings accounts earning meager interest may tempt and normalize bank-hopping. If forced to compete by comparison-shopping bots, dozens of banks would see profits evaporate.
item.dc:creator: Stephen Gandel
item.content:encoded: Software makers menaced by automated coding tools suffered a “SaaSpocalypse.” Now US banks face their own end times. Digital assistants like Meta Platforms’ (META.O) Muse could help once-complacent consumers move their cash out of low- or no-interest accounts. Right now, this danger is totally theoretical. In the worst case, though, every lender from JPMorgan (JPM.N) on down would suffer. Muse’s launch is the latest cause for an AI-related panic, this time about so-called agents yanking the $5.7 trillion Americans keep in savings and checking deposits. Bankers argue that rewards programs and lessons learned from Silicon Valley Bank’s digitally accelerated collapse will be ample defense. They should hope so. Savers have long been [USN:L6N3Z20AL TEXT:"short changed"] by banks, particularly the biggest ones. Figures from the Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation show the average US savings account yielded only 0.37% in September, compared with the 3.75% offered to institutions depositing funds at the Federal Reserve. Whether because of inertia or customer loyalty, this is cheap funding for the industry, which has fought to protect it. A push under President Joe Biden to establish open-banking standards that would have made switching accounts easier became the target of heavy lobbying and failed. AI agents could now eliminate much of that friction. That’s especially dangerous when upstart digital-finance rivals offer yields sometimes exceeding 4%. Banks can’t just watch their deposits evaporate: in a worst-case world, they would have to raise their rates to compete. More than 500 lenders, accounting for nearly 85% of US banking assets, disclose consumer and commercial deposits separately. As of midyear, they paid an average rate of 1.9% across all accounts, according to data from KBRA Financial Intelligence. Start with the $3.8 trillion consumers hold in their savings accounts. Raising rates on these deposits to 4% would increase interest payments by $79 billion annually, enough to wipe out net income at 32 institutions, Breakingviews calculates, based on regulatory filings in KBRA's database. Day-to-day checking accounts, comprising roughly $1.9 trillion of deposits, are more finicky, providing emergency cash and paying off recurring bills. Still, if consumers learn to trust bots enough to let them transfer all but minimal balances over to products offering 4%, as many as 78 banks, with combined assets of $1.3 trillion, might tip into the red. These are extreme assumptions, and they don't take into account any tax savings the banks might get from higher interest expenses, or other offsets. Most crucially, Muse cannot yet actually open bank accounts. Lenders can deploy their own AI tools or restrict automated transfers. Years after SVB’s collapse, though, the specter of the truly mobile deposit still haunts Wall Street. Follow Stephen Gandel on LinkedIn and X . Muse's Muse AI agent reached 5 million downloads in September, the first month it was widely available, according to market intelligence firm Sensor Tower. CONTEXT-NEWS

item.title: EU Commission floats safeguards against democratic backsliding by new members
item.description: The European Commission proposed measures on Tuesday to prepare the EU to take in countries such as Montenegro, Albania, Ukraine and Moldova in coming years while trying to reassure existing members about potential political and economic costs.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: The European Commission proposed measures on Tuesday to prepare the EU to take in countries such as Montenegro, Albania, Ukraine and Moldova in coming years while trying to reassure existing members about potential political and economic costs. The proposals by the European Union’s executive body reflect a renewed interest among EU members in [USN:L6N45L0VW TEXT:"expanding"] the 27-nation bloc, driven largely by Russia’s 2022 invasion of Ukraine and Kyiv’s desire to join the bloc as part of a peace settlement. The proposed reforms include a measure to allow other EU countries to suspend a new member's voting rights during the first 15 years of membership if it stops adhering to the bloc’s values, and a plan to limit financial support to Ukraine’s large farming sector. The Commission also proposed strengthening an existing policy of gradually integrating would-be members into EU programmes and economic sectors such as energy, transport, digital and defence. But countries would have to meet criteria for each scheme and align with the EU’s overall strategic direction. The small Balkan state of Montenegro is likely to be the next country ready to join the bloc, possibly wrapping up negotiations by the end of this year, according to EU officials. Albania, Moldova and Ukraine are also seen as frontrunners but are probably at least still several years away from membership. "As enlargement countries advance on their path of reform, the EU must be ready to welcome them," European Commission President Ursula von der Leyen said in a written statement. "This means preparing our institutions, adapting our policies for new realities, and ensuring our budget reflects our shared ambitions." The Commission's suggestions will require approval from the EU's current 27 member states to become reality. Those countries are expected to begin discussions on the proposals in the coming days.

item.title: アイスランドは北大西洋・北極圏防衛の要、安保協力継続が重要＝米国務長官
item.description: ［６日 ロイター］ -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
［６日　ロイター］ - ルビオ米国務長官は６日、訪問先のアイスランドで同国のグンナルスドッティル外相と共同記者会見を行い、アイスランドは北大西洋・北極圏防衛で中核的な役割を担っているとし、脅威が増大する中、安全保障分野で協力を継続することが重要だと述べた。

ルビオ長官は北極圏の軍事、経済、インフラ面での脅威への懸念に言及した上で、「アイスランドは米軍による戦力投射を可能にしてきた。アイスランドの陸・空・海の領域を活用しながら協力することで、秘密活動を監視し、敵対勢力を抑止するための重要な拠点を提供している」と述べた。

その上で「アイスランドの地理的位置は、欧州だけでなく米国本土の防衛にとっても極めて重要だ」とし、「さらに何ができるかを探るため協議を行う用意がある。双方が協力拡大に関心を持っていると認識している」と語った。

item.title: Marvell raises 2028 revenue forecast on strong AI data center demand
item.description: Marvell Technology raised its fiscal 2028 revenue forecast to about $20 billion on Tuesday, above Wall Street estimates, as demand for its custom data center chips grows along with a surge in AI spending.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Marvell Technology (MRVL.O) raised its fiscal 2028 revenue forecast to about $20 billion on Tuesday, above Wall Street estimates, as demand for its custom data center chips grows along with a surge in AI spending. Shares of the company rose about 7%, while those of rival Broadcom (AVGO.O) advanced about 4% in early trading. Marvell had outlined a strategy centered on custom and cloud-optimized silicon — chips specifically designed for use in data centers — at its 2021 investor day. It has been one of the biggest beneficiaries of the AI infrastructure boom since then. The company's custom chip business has become a major growth engine, with technology companies developing in-house AI processors to reduce reliance on Nvidia (NVDA.O) chips. The chipmaker's stock has more than tripled in value so far this year. Marvell disclosed a deal with Alphabet's Google (GOOGL.O) in August that could generate up to $120 billion in sales through fiscal 2033, if performance milestones are achieved. That same month, it raised its full-year revenue outlook to about $18 billion from $16.5 billion. On Tuesday, Marvell forecast fiscal 2031 revenue of $70 billion to $90 billion. At $80 billion, the midpoint of that range exceeds Wall Street estimates of $46.85 billion, according to four analysts polled by Visible Alpha. Analysts were expecting revenue of $18.2 billion for 2028, according to data compiled by LSEG.

FAST

Oct 6 : US software stocks are touching fresh 2026 highs, supported by a sharp rise in earnings expectations, which according to several analysts indicate that fears over AI-led disruption in the sector were largely overstated. The S&P 500 software and services index rose 1.3 per cent on Tuesday to its highest levels since November 2025, after posting its biggest quarterly jump in July-September since the second quarter of 2020. Strong earnings from software companies such as Salesforce, ServiceNow and Accenture, along with partnerships with AI labs, helped fuel a recovery in the sector that had been underway since late June. Cybersecurity stocks have stood out, with Crowdstrike, Fortinet and Palo Alto Networks notching triple digit percentage gains this year as companies spend heavily on cybersecurity in the age of AI.

"AI has been more of an enabler for a lot of these software companies, more than a disruptor," said Adam Turnquist, chief cross-asset strategist at LPL Financial. "We're seeing more of a trend change now where software has recaptured the leadership reins, and we think there's a window here for outperformance in software over semiconductors." The software index is up 5 per cent this year while the Philadelphia SE Semiconductor index, home to many US chipmakers, has surged 87.5 per cent in 2026, but is well off its highs. The sector's expected annual earnings growth rate for 2026 has climbed to 20.6 per cent, up from 13.8 per cent at the end of March, according to LSEG data. 'SAASPOCALYPSE' FEARS OVERDONE The software index lost more than 26 per cent from late January to its lowest point in April, in a selloff dubbed "SaaSpocalypse", driven by fears that companies could use AI to build applications in-house more cheaply. Analysts now say the fear ran ahead of evidence. "The whole SaaSpocalypse didn't happen anywhere near as fast as some of the people on Wall Street thought it would," said Rebecca Wettemann, CEO of technology research firm Valoir, adding that vendors were reporting customer uptake as AI adoption moved beyond the experimental stage. Still, risks to the sector persist as the fast-evolving technology upends business models. Brian Mulberry, chief market strategist at Zacks Investment Management, said the real test for software stocks could come in the second half of 2027, when more data center capacity might make AI coding a bigger threat to traditional software firms.

Source: Reuters

item.title: Ｇ７の石油備蓄放出、詳細を14─15日のＩＥＡ理事会で決定へ＝関係筋
item.description:
Giuseppe Fonte Kate Abnett Alex Lawler
[ローマ／ロンドン ６日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
Giuseppe Fonte　Kate Abnett　Alex Lawler

[ローマ／ロンドン　６日　ロイター] - 国際エネルギー機関（ＩＥＡ）の理事会は、主要７カ国（Ｇ７）が先週発表したディーゼル燃料（軽油）および原油の備蓄放出に関する詳細を、１０月１４─１５日の会合で決定する見通しだ。この件に詳しい関係筋２人が６日、明らかにした。供給不足と過去最高水準の価格に対応するため、欧米がどれだけの量を放出するのかを巡り、市場で不透明感が広がっている。

Ｇ７は２日の首脳共同声明で、世界のエネルギー市場の安定化に向け、ＩＥＡを通じてディーゼル燃料などの石油備蓄１億バレルを協調放出すると発表した。ただ、放出する原油、ディーゼル燃料、その他の製品の数量の内訳や、どの国が参加するのかは明らかにしていなかった。

関係筋の１人によると、Ｇ７加盟国であるイタリアが放出に加わる見通しだという。

ＩＥＡは、詳細が理事会で決定されるかどうかについてのコメント要請に対し、直ちには回答しなかった。

欧州委員会の報道官は６日、ＥＵの石油調整グループが７日に会合を開くと明らかにした。

ホワイトハウスは、備蓄放出の詳細を明らかにするよう求めたコメント要請に直ちには回答しなかった。

石油市場関係者や一部のＥＵ加盟国の政府当局者も、Ｇ７の２日の発表の詳細について情報収集に追われている。商品取引大手ビトルのラッセル・ハーディ最高経営責任者（ＣＥＯ）は６日、ロンドンで開かれた会議で、「具体的に何がどこで放出されるのか、十分に明確な発表ではなかった」とし、同社も備蓄放出の詳細をなお把握しようとしていると述べた。

Oct 6 : Computer-memory company Netlist announced on Tuesday that Micron would pay $600 million to settle a patent dispute over Micron's memory chips. • Netlist said in a statement that Micron would pay $30 million per quarter for a five-year license to Netlist's patent portfolio that includes its "high bandwidth memory" technology • Netlist won a $445 million patent infringement verdict against Micron in Marshall, Texas, federal court in 2024 • Netlist filed a new infringement complaint against Micron at the US International Trade Commission in September seeking to block imports of Micron chips used in Google, Nvidia and Broadcom products for AI computing

FAST

Oct 6 : Citigroup estimates Meta's AI assistant Muse could generate more than $27 billion in revenue by 2030 as strong user adoption and growing engagement reinforce the platform's first-mover advantage in the emerging personal agent market. The brokerage said Muse is increasingly becoming the "front door to the internet," helping users search, compare and transact online, while Meta expands awareness and positions the product at the center of its broader AI strategy. • Citi said Muse's cumulative downloads have topped 6.6 million since its launch, while daily active users reached 1.8 million as new use cases emerge and Meta ramps up awareness efforts • The brokerage estimates Muse could account for more than $27 billion in annual revenue by 2030, including about $23 billion from transaction-related revenue and roughly $4.5 billion from subscriptions

• Unveiled last month, Muse is key to Meta's strategy to bring AI-powered personal agents to mainstream users, with the company betting the technology can drive new subscription and commerce revenue while deepening engagement across its ecosystem • "With Muse the centerpiece of Meta's AI vision to be a key part of a user's daily life, we believe personal agents (PAs)— with Muse benefiting from its 1st-mover advantage, are emerging as the new front door to the internet," Citi said • Muse's first-mover advantage could prove crucial as competitors such as OpenAI's ChatGPT Dots, Google's Gemini and Anthropic's Claude expand their own agent offerings in pursuit of what many view as the next major consumer computing platform • Meta's stock has risen 12.4 per cent year-to-date and more than 20 per cent since Muse debuted on September 8, leaving Meta within striking distance of a $2 trillion market value

item.title: 米8月貿易赤字、1056億ドルと25年3月以来の高水準
item.description: [ワシントン ６日 ロイター] - 米商務省が６日発表した８月の貿易赤字（季節調整済み）は前月比１３．７％増の１０５６億...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
米8月貿易赤字、1056億ドルと25年3月以来の高水準 10/6 22:42 配信

米カリフォルニア州ロングビーチ港沖に停泊するコンテナ船。７月撮影。REUTERS/Mario Anzuoni

[ワシントン　６日　ロイター] - 米商務省が６日発表した８月の貿易赤字（季節調整済み）は前月比１３．７％増の１０５６億ドルと、２０２５年３月以来の高水準となった。堅調な内需を背景に輸入が過去最高を記録し、ロイターがまとめたエコノミスト予想（１０２０億ドル）を上回った。第３・四半期も貿易が経済成長の押し下げ要因となる見通しとなった。

８月の輸入は４．３％増の４２０８億ドルと過去最高となった。モノの輸入は５．３％増の３４２２億ドル。石油を含む工業用資材・原材料が９１億ドル増加したことが押し上げ要因となった。

原油の輸入は３３億ドル増、非貨幣用金は３１億ドル増加した。資本財の輸入は、半導体やその他の産業機械がけん引し、６２億ドル増の１４６４億ドルと過去最高となった。一方、コンピューター周辺機器は１６億ドル減少した。

サービス輸入は１億ドル弱の増加にとどまり、７８５億ドルとなった。輸送サービスが小幅に増加した一方、知的財産使用料や旅行サービスは減少した。

８月の輸出は１．４％増の３１５２億ドル、モノの輸出は２．２％増の２０５７億ドルとなった。工業用資材・原材料が６３億ドル増加した。資本財の輸出は、半導体とコンピューターに押し上げられ１３億ドル増加。一方、民間航空機は１０億ドル減少した。 消費財の輸出は２２億ドル減少。医薬品が２４億ドル減少したことが響いた。

サービス輸出は１０９５億ドルと、１億ドル弱の増加にとどまった。知的財産使用料とその他ビジネスサービスが小幅に増加した一方、旅行サービスと金融サービスはともに減少した。

貿易は３四半期連続で国内総生産（ＧＤＰ）の押し下げ要因となっており、エコノミストらは第３・四半期のＧＤＰを最大２．５％ポイント押し下げる可能性があると試算している。

第３・四半期の成長率予想は概ね年率３．０％を上回っており、個人消費が輸入によるマイナス影響を相殺すると見込まれている。第２・四半期の成長率は２．２％だった。

トランプ大統領は貿易赤字の縮小に向けて輸入品に対する強硬な関税措置を講じてきたものの、赤字は逆に拡大し、メキシコ、ベトナム、マレーシアに対するモノの貿易赤字は過去最大となった。台湾、中国、欧州連合（ＥＵ）、韓国、カナダ、インドなどに対しても引き続き赤字となった。一方、ベルギーに対するモノの貿易黒字は過去最大を記録。オランダ、中南米、英国、香港、ブラジル、オーストラリア、サウジアラビアに対しても黒字を維持した。

ＦＷＤＢＯＮＤＳのチーフエコノミスト、クリストファー・ラプキー氏は「現政権の通商政策は概ね失敗に終わっており、関税措置は米国が外国製品への依存を低減することに何ら寄与していない」と指摘。「米国の労働コストは高過ぎるため、消費者が購入を検討できるほど安価な商品を国内で生産することはできない。たとえ米国の製造業者にその意思があったとしても、消費者が依存している商品を生産するための工場を国内に素早く建設することはできないだろう」と述べた。
