item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: In Deutschland gibt es erstmals einen Parlamentspräsidenten aus den Reihen der in Teilen als rechtsextrem eingestuften AfD. Der Landtag in Sachsen-Anhalt wählte in seiner konstituierenden Sitzung am Dienstag den AfD-Abgeordneten Tobias Rausch zu seinem Präsidenten. Weil er bei der geheimen Wahl 48 der 82 abgegebenen Stimmen bekam, löste dies eine parteipolitische Debatte auch auf Bundesebene aus. Denn die AfD und das sie unterstützende BSW verfügen zusammen nur über 44 Stimmen. Die SPD forderte von der CDU Aufklärung, ob deren Abgeordnete für Rausch gestimmt hatten. Dies werde auch Thema im Koalitionsausschuss der schwarz-roten Regierung am Mittwoch in Berlin werden, kündigte SPD-Fraktionschef Matthias Miersch an. CDU/CSU-Fraktionschef Thorsten Frei sagte, er sehe die Wahl in Magdeburg "mit allergrößter Besorgnis". Das gelte auch dafür, dass Rausch vier Stimmen mehr als erwartet bekommen habe. Zugleich wies er es als "reine Spekulation" zurück, dass CDU-Abgeordnete für diese vier Stimmen verantwortlich seien. Aber die Wahl an sich sei "in höchstem Maße bedenklich und besorgniserregend". Am Nachmittag wurde zudem der AfD-Politiker Hans-Thomas Tillschneider zu einem der Landtags-Vizepräsidenten gewählt. Bei 82 abgegebenen Stimmen erhielt er 44 Ja-Stimmen. Es gab 38 Nein-Stimmen und keine Enthaltungen. Rausch hatte 48-Ja-Stimmen bekommen, bei 29 Nein-Stimmen und 5 Enthaltungen. AfD-Wahlsieger Ulrich Siegmund hat angekündigt, sich im Dezember im Landtag als Kandidat für das Amt des Ministerpräsidenten zur Wahl stellen zu wollen. Ihm fehlt eine Mehrheit, weil die anderen Parteien keine Koalition mit der AfD eingehen wollen. Auch das BSW lehnt eine formelle Zusammenarbeit mit der AfD ab, hat aber angekündigt, sich in einem dritten Wahlgang enthalten zu wollen. Dann würde für die Wahl Siegmunds eine einfache Mehrheit ausreichen - dann müsste der AfD-Politiker aber mit einer Minderheitsregierung regieren, was er bisher abgelehnt hat. Bis zu einer erfolgreichen Wahl eines neuen Regierungschefs ist Ministerpräsident Sven Schulze (CDU) geschäftsführend weiter im Amt. CSU-Landesgruppenchef Hoffmann warf der AfD vor, "demokratiefeindlich" zu sein. Das sehe man daran, dass die AfD in Sachsen-Anhalt nur 100 Prozent AfD und keinen Kompromiss eingehen wolle. Es gehe der AfD nur darum, das demokratische System zu zersetzen. Er glaube, dass die AfD durch das Verhalten Siegmunds "ein Stück weit entzaubert" werde, auch für ihre Wähler. Denn offensichtlich wolle sie die Zusage nicht einhalten, etwas zu ändern.

item.title: London stocks gain on softer oil, easing gilt yields; Defence shares fall
item.description: The UK's FTSE 100 advanced on Tuesday as a retreat in bond yields and softer oil prices calmed investors following last week's bond-market volatility, while losses in defence stocks capped gains.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: The UK's FTSE 100 advanced on Tuesday as a retreat in bond yields and softer oil prices calmed investors following last week's bond-market volatility, while losses in defence stocks capped gains. The blue-chip FTSE 100 index (.FTSE) rose 0.4% to 24,215.33 points, while the midcap FTSE 250 (.FTMC) also climbed 0.4%. Brent crude oil declined 2% as resilient Middle Eastern crude exports and a G7 emergency stockpile release eased supply concerns, although continued security risks in the Middle East limited further losses. Government borrowing costs also eased after 10- and 30-year gilt yields , surged to multi-decade highs last week, as investors weighed persistent inflation and debt concerns. Bank of England policymaker Catherine Mann [USN:L8N45S0KH TEXT:"warned"] that inflation has become embedded in the UK economy and could become further entrenched as wage negotiations pick up early next year Markets see about a 90% probability of a 25-basis-point or larger BoE rate hike in November, according to LSEG data. Defence stocks fell, with BAE Systems (BAES.L) , Babcock International (BAB.L) and Rolls-Royce (RR.L) down between 2% and 4%. A Times report said the government was considering delaying plans to set out a path towards [USN:L8N45S0CO TEXT:"lifting defence spending to 3% of GDP"]. Informa (INF.L) was among top FTSE 100 gainers, rising 3%. The exhibitions group said it would [USN:L4N45S0CT TEXT:"buy events organiser Clarion"] for £2.24 billion ($2.98 billion) and spin off its Taylor & Francis academic publishing division "While separating off the academic publishing business means there is little else to support the business if live events struggle, it at least recognises where the real growth in the business will continue to be," said Chris Beauchamp, chief market analyst at IG. On the FTSE 250, shipping services provider Clarkson (CKN.L) rose 2.2% after forecasting annual underlying [USN:L6N45S0BI TEXT:"pretax profit above market expectations"]. ASOS (ASOS.L) dropped 9.6% after [USN:L6N45S0OD TEXT:"media reports"] said customers of the online fashion retailer had received push notifications saying it had been hacked and threatening to leak information. The firm said basic personal information might have been accessed but that it did not believe payment-card information or account passwords had been affected. ($1 = 0.7528 pounds)

item.title: Emera bulks up for power demand boom with $10 billion Canadian Utilities deal
item.description: Emera said on Tuesday it would buy peer Canadian Utilities for C$14.3 billion ($10.02 billion) in stock, strengthening its financial muscle as power companies ramp up investments to tap into booming demand.
item.dc:creator: Katha Kalia
item.content:encoded: Emera (EMA.TO) said on Tuesday it would buy peer Canadian Utilities (CU.TO) for C$14.3 billion ($10.02 billion) in stock, strengthening its financial muscle as power companies ramp up investments to tap into booming demand. The deal, which will create one of Canada's top power providers with an enterprise value of about C$72 billion, comes when utilities across North America move ahead with costly upgrades of aging grid and transmission infrastructure. "As demand rises from electrification trends and major infrastructure development, the combined company will be better positioned to help meet growing energy needs," Emera CEO Scott Balfour, who will lead the combined company, said in a statement. US power firms NextEra Energy (NEE.N) and Dominion Energy (D.N) in May [USN:L4N41V0YN TEXT:"agreed to merge"] in a $66.8 billion deal amid soaring electricity demand fueled by the rapid expansion of data centers supporting the adoption of AI. Emera said the deal would support a planned C$32 billion capital program through 2030, with an expected annual rate-base growth of 7% to 8%. The combined company will have about 6 million customers and a presence in high-growth markets through a portfolio of 12 regulated utilities. "Florida and Alberta will become the company's two largest jurisdictions, representing approximately 45% and 34% respectively," Balfour said in a conference call. DEAL CLOSING IN 2027 Under the offer, Class A shareholders of Canadian Utilities, excluding ATCO (ACOx.TO) , will receive 0.755 Emera shares and Class B shareholders will get 0.819 for each share held. The deal values Canadian Utilities' Class A shares at about C$51.57 each, a premium of roughly 0.7% to the stock's close on Monday, according to LSEG data. Meanwhile, ATCO, which holds nearly 37% of the outstanding non-voting shares and all outstanding voting shares of Canadian Utilities, will separate into a publicly traded industrial services company. Emera shares were down 1.2%, Canadian Utilities rose 1.4% and ATCO jumped 12.8% in morning trading. The deal is expected to close in the third or fourth quarter of 2027 and add to earnings per share in the first full year following the completion. The new company will operate as Emera and maintain its public company headquarters in Halifax. ($1 = 1.4270 Canadian dollars)

item.title: Becton Dickinson pledges $19 billion US investment in deal with government
item.description: Becton Dickinson became the first major US medical device company to strike a deal with the government to expand its domestic manufacturing, pledging $19 billion over several years in return for shelter from future tariffs.
item.dc:creator: Siddhi Mahatole
item.content:encoded: Becton Dickinson (BDX.N) became the first major US medical device company to strike a deal with the government to expand its domestic manufacturing, pledging $19 billion over several years in return for shelter from future tariffs. Under the agreement, the company on Tuesday said it plans to make capital, operational and supply chain investments in the US, with $3 billion earmarked for strategic manufacturing sites across the country. Shares of the medical device maker were up 2.4% in morning trading. The deal follows the Trump administration's [USN:L4N3TZ1L7 TEXT:"push"] to use tariff threats to spur domestic healthcare manufacturing, with [USN:L4N4470VR TEXT:"major drugmakers already pledging billions"] for new and expanded US production and research facilities. The agreement ties BD's US manufacturing commitments to relief from future tariffs on covered products and inputs under Section 232, subject to the final scope of the measures and the company meeting agreed milestones. "We think tariff clarity or the potential for levies to be 'less bad' than feared could be a clearing event for MedTech," said Jefferies analyst Mathew Taylor, adding "we wonder if there are more MedTech announcements in the works." The company plans to expand US production by about 5 billion essential medical consumables annually, raising the share it supplies domestically to roughly 80%. It also plans to manufacture all needles used in the US domestically using American-made steel. Becton Dickinson said it was not currently quantifying the financial impact of the agreement because the final tariff rates, product scope and timing have not yet been determined. The announcement builds on President Donald Trump's [USN:L1N45S036 TEXT:"statement on Monday"] that the company had agreed to invest $3 billion to bring manufacturing of essential medical products to the United States, with more than $1 billion going to Nebraska. In January, Becton announced a $110 million investment in Columbus, Nebraska, to expand prefillable syringe and cannula production, adding about 120 jobs, with syringe production expected to begin supplying customers in mid-2026.

item.title: Google enters massive 3.6-GW power deal with Constellation Energy
item.description: Google has contracted for 3,590 megawatts of power from Constellation Energy in the largest US power grid, with new nuclear energy accounting for about a quarter of that supply, the companies said on Tuesday.
item.dc:creator: Laila Kearney
item.content:encoded: Google (GOOGL.O) has contracted for 3,590 megawatts of power from Constellation Energy (CEG.O) in the largest US power grid, with new nuclear energy accounting for about a quarter of that supply, the companies said on Tuesday. Constellation will make more than $4.3 billion of new investments in its fleet as part of the agreement, which involves adding capacity at several of the power company's nuclear reactors in the Midwest and Mid-Atlantic regions, the companies said. Major tech companies are racing to secure massive amounts of electricity supplies to power data centers across the US by striking unprecedented power deals and reviving the country's nuclear industry. Over the last two years, Constellation unveiled an agreement to restart its [USN:L1N3LU103 TEXT:"Three Mile Island reactor "]in Pennsylvania to serve Microsoft (MSFT.O) data centers, while Google contracted [USN:L4N3W81GR TEXT:"to restart "]NextEra Energy's (NEE.N) nuclear power plant in Iowa. In the latest arrangement, Google entered into a 20-year power purchase agreement for 890 megawatts of electricity from multiple Constellation-owned nuclear power plants, which would be upgraded to produce more electricity from existing reactors. Electricity from the first of the upgraded plants is expected to be delivered in 2028, the companies said. Google also entered into a 15-year supply agreement for an additional 2,700 megawatts of power from Constellation in the PJM power grid. That power is not tied to a specific generation source and serves as long-term revenue certainty for Constellation's operating plants, Google said. Shares of Constellation were up by more than 13% on Tuesday to $304.04 by mid-morning. Maryland-based Constellation is the largest US nuclear power plant operator and owns a major fleet of natural-gas-fired power plants as well as geothermal energy following its [USN:L4N3O60SW TEXT:"acquisition of electricity producer"] Calpine Corp earlier this year. "We’re committed to meeting our growth responsibly by actively investing in clean, reliable power that brings new capacity to our nation's grids," said Amanda Peterson Corio, Google's global head of energy and power, in a statement. The 11 nuclear units expected to be upgraded as part of the arrangement with Google are in Illinois, Pennsylvania, and New Jersey, within the footprint of the largest US electric grid -- PJM Interconnection. Rising electricity demand driven largely by the data center expansion has contributed to a more than 11-fold increase in PJM capacity prices since 2024 and left the grid with a power shortfall. In response, PJM management has proposed requiring data center customers connected to the 13-state grid to either bring their own power or face being shut off from grid power remotely in times of peak demand. The deal between Google and Constellation is in response to PJM's "bring your own power" proposal. It also creates a "practical model for how major power consumers can expand new supply alongside growing operational requirements, without state or federal mandates," the companies said. Google and Constellation also agreed on a strategic framework that can be replicated to develop power generation, battery storage, and a flexible power use model known as "demand response" in other parts of the US, the companies said. Joe Dominguez, chairman, president and CEO of Constellation, said the arrangement with Google is a "model for how technology companies and the energy industry can work together to responsibly develop the digital economy and invest in our nation’s energy infrastructure in a way that delivers grid-wide benefits for all, funded by private entities."

item.title: サウジ東西パイプライン、送油量580万バレル＝エネ相
item.description: [６日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
[６日 ロイター] - サウジアラビアのアブドルアジズエネルギー相は６日、紅海沿岸の石油輸出拠点ヤンブーに通じる東西パイプラインの送油量が、同日朝の時点で５８０万バレルに達したと明らかにした。

サウジとイエメンの親イラン武装組織フーシ派との戦闘が続く中、同パイプラインで最近、送油が中断したとの報道があったが、関係筋は５日、ロイターに対し中断はしていないと述べた。

関係筋３人によると、サウジは東西パイプラインの操業を再開した。同パイプラインはイラクの民兵組織によるものとされる無人機（ドローン）攻撃を受け、９月１１日に送油を停止し、ヤンブーでの原油の積み込みも中断していた。

item.title: S&P 500, Nasdaq hit record highs as Treasury yields stall, oil slips
item.description: The benchmark S&P 500 and the Nasdaq hit record highs on Tuesday as Treasury yields eased from multi-year highs and oil prices fell, while investors looked ahead to the upcoming quarterly earnings season.
item.dc:creator: Tharuniyaa Lakshmi, Shashwat Chauhan
item.content:encoded: The benchmark S&P 500 and the Nasdaq hit record highs on Tuesday as Treasury yields eased from multi-year highs and oil prices fell, while investors looked ahead to the upcoming quarterly earnings season. Most of the 'Magnificent Seven' stocks ticked higher, with Meta (META.O) , Tesla (TSLA.O) , Amazon.com (AMZN.O) and Microsoft (MSFT.O) all up between 0.5% and 1.7%. Chip designer Nvidia (NVDA.O) climbed 1.1%, pushing the market valuation of the world's most valuable company close to the $6 trillion mark. Optimism surrounding the AI trade and hopes of strong corporate earnings lifted US equities lately, further boosting the bull market that began in October 2022 despite higher energy prices and a volatile summer for bond markets that fueled concerns about tighter monetary policy. "The economy continues to be more resilient than many expected, and corporate earnings remain strong, but the big change is rising interest rates," said David Miller, chief investment officer at Catalyst Funds. "Investors are now dealing with meaningfully higher long-term rates ... I am still bullish on equities, but the hurdle has gone up significantly." Government bond yields eased across the curve, including a 5.3-basis-point decline for the benchmark 10-year bond . A soft payrolls report last week reduced chances of an interest rate hike in October, with traders now seeing a near 79% chance of a hold, though a December rate hike remains largely priced in, according to the CME Group's FedWatch tool. On Tuesday, at least four Fed officials, including New York Fed President John Williams, are slated to deliver public remarks. All 11 S&P 500 sectors were trading higher, with utilities (.SPLRCU) and real estate (.SPLRCR) leading the gains. At 11:33 a.m. ET, the Dow Jones Industrial Average (.DJI) rose 359.08 points, or 0.70%, to 51,626.98, the S&P 500 (.SPX) gained 66.16 points, or 0.86%, to 7,840.66 and the Nasdaq Composite (.IXIC) gained 228.58 points, or 0.83%, to 27,705.89. Oil prices, meanwhile, fell around 2% as resilient Middle Eastern crude exports and a G7 emergency stockpile release eased supply concerns. The third-quarter earnings season will kick off next week. Analysts on average expect S&P 500 earnings to jump over 30% year over year in the quarter, thanks largely to AI-related stocks, according to LSEG data. Marvell Technology (MRVL.O) climbed 6.5% after the [USN:L6N45S0Y5 TEXT:"chip designer"] raised its 2028 revenue forecast to about $20 billion on Tuesday, citing strong demand for its chips used in data centers. Chipmaker AMD (AMD.O) gained 3.6% after CEO Lisa Su said [USN:L6N45S09C TEXT:"the company planned"] to substantially increase chip supply in 2027 to meet booming AI demand. Constellation Energy (CEG.O) was the top gainer on the S&P 500, up 13.9% after Alphabet's Google (GOOGL.O) entered into a 3,590-megawatt power [USN:L6N45S04O TEXT:"deal"] with the company. Option Care Health (OPCH.O) jumped 32.7% after drug distributor McKesson (MCK.N) and private equity firm Clayton Dubilier & Rice [USN:L4N45S0SZ TEXT:"agreed to buy"] the infusion therapy provider in a deal worth about $5.8 billion, including debt. Advancing issues outnumbered decliners by a 2.93-to-1 ratio on the NYSE and by a 1.72-to-1 ratio on the Nasdaq. The S&P 500 posted 21 new 52-week highs and one new low, while the Nasdaq Composite recorded 48 new highs and 123 new lows.

item.title: 米中、核施設相互視察を協議 中国が提案とＣＮＮ報道
item.description: ［６日 ロイター］ -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
［６日　ロイター］ - 米ＣＮＮは６日、米国が中国との間で核施設相互視察の開始について協議しており、今後数カ月の間に予定されている対面会談でも、その実現に向けて引き続き働きかけていく方針だと報じた。

ＣＮＮが関係筋の話として伝えたところによると、相互訪問の構想は今年行われた米中当局者の協議で中国側が提起し、米エネルギー省傘下の国立研究所や中国の同等施設への訪問が検討された。米中当局者協議は主に、国連安全保障理事会常任理事国の会合の合間に行われてきたという。

トランプ米大統領は先月、中国の習近平国家主席と会談した際、米中ロ３カ国による軍備管理交渉を呼びかけた。中国はかねて、自国の核戦力はロシアや米国に比べてはるかに小さく、そうした協議への参加は不要だとの立場を示している。

ＣＮＮは、米政府当局者の話として、両首脳が会談で核施設訪問の可能性について協議しなかったと伝えた。その上で、両首脳が再会談するまでに、核施設訪問の可能性を巡る実務レベルの協議がさらに行われる見通しだとした。

トランプ氏と習近平国家主席の年内の再会談は公算が大きいと広く見られており、１１月に中国で開催されるアジア太平洋経済協力会議（ＡＰＥＣ）首脳会議、または１２月に米国で開かれる２０カ国・地域（Ｇ２０）会合の機会に行われる可能性がある。

item.title: Catalan separatist Puigdemont set to return home after court lifts arrest warrant
item.description: Spain's two top courts cleared the way on Tuesday for self-exiled Catalan separatist leader Carles Puigdemont to return without being arrested, just as Spain is gearing up for an early national election.
item.dc:creator: Joan Faus, Emma Pinedo
item.content:encoded: Spain's two top courts cleared the way on Tuesday for self-exiled Catalan separatist leader Carles Puigdemont to return without being arrested, just as Spain is gearing up for an [USN:L8N45R05N TEXT:"early national election"]. The Constitutional Court ruled that an amnesty law for Catalan separatists applies to embezzlement charges against Puigdemont. Shortly afterwards, the Supreme Court responded by lifting a warrant for Puigdemont's arrest. The likely homecoming of the former Catalan head of government could further unsettle an already volatile political landscape ahead of the November 29 election. Puigdemont fled to Belgium in 2017 after holding an independence referendum for his region that Madrid had declared illegal. "It's a great victory for President Puigdemont and the two other exiled" leaders in Belgium, Jordi Turull, secretary general of Puigdemont's party Junts, told reporters. "They held firm, they resisted, they prevailed in Europe and today they have prevailed against the Spanish state." He declined to say when Puigdemont might return, but ruled out his running in the upcoming election. Prime Minister Pedro Sanchez had enacted the amnesty under a 2023 agreement between his Socialist Party and two Catalan parties, including Puigdemont's Junts, in exchange for their support for him to remain prime minister. The move triggered intense social and political opposition from the government's critics at the time. The Supreme Court had initially ruled that the amnesty did not apply to the crime of embezzlement, which meant Puigdemont and others could still be arrested on charges of embezzling the funds that were spent on the referendum. But the Constitutional Court, which has a progressive-leaning majority, ruled in an appeal that disallowing the amnesty for embezzlement unconnected with private enrichment would violate the purpose of the amnesty law. "The ruling is in line with expectations, as we had always maintained that the amnesty law was constitutional and also consistent with European Union law," Puigdemont's lawyer, Gonzalo Boye, told Reuters. A year ago, Junts withdrew its support for the minority central government. Unable to pass laws, Sanchez [USN:L8N45R0N4 TEXT:"called"] the snap election on Monday. Sanchez told reporters on Tuesday he did not regret launching the amnesty, and welcomed the court ruling. "I believe the important message is that of coexistence among Catalans," he said. FRESH DRAMA Although separatism has [USN:L8N4590Z7 TEXT:"lost ground"] and Junts is trailing in opinion polls, Puigdemont's return could spark fresh political drama. Spain's conservative People's Party is leading in opinion polls ahead of the election and may need to seek the support of Junts and other centre-right parties to govern. Catalonia unilaterally [USN:KBN1CB272 TEXT:"declared independence"] from Spain in 2017 after the referendum. Although some 90% of voters backed independence, Catalans who wanted to remain part of Spain mostly boycotted the ballot and many polling stations were shut. Puigdemont then fled the country, while several of his former ministers, including Turull, stayed and were jailed until later being pardoned by Sanchez.

item.title: Canada's TSX edges up as bond yields retreat, utility shares advance
item.description: Canada's benchmark stock index inched higher on Tuesday, with utilities leading gains, as a pullback in global bond yields and easing oil prices supported sentiment, although weakness in energy and mining shares capped advances.
item.dc:creator: Avinash P
item.content:encoded: Canada's benchmark stock index inched higher on Tuesday, with utilities leading gains, as a pullback in global bond yields and easing oil prices supported sentiment, although weakness in energy and mining shares capped advances. The Toronto Stock Exchange's S&P/TSX Composite Index (.GSPTSE) rose 0.19% to 35,587.45 points by 10:08 a.m. ET and was on track for its third straight day of gains. Utilities (.GSPTTUT) rose 1%, leading gains, as global bond yields retreated Emera (EMA.TO) said it would acquire Canadian Utilities (CU.TO) in an [USN:L4N45S0P5 TEXT:"all-stock deal worth C$14.3 billion"] ($10.02 billion), creating one of Canada's largest utilities Emera fell 2%, while Canadian Utilities inched higher marginally. ATCO (ACOx.TO) jumped 12.8% after saying it would spin off into a standalone publicly traded industrial services company called New ATCO Oil fell by more than $2 as rising Middle Eastern crude exports and a G7 emergency stockpile release eased supply concerns, with Brent Crude dipping below $100 a barrel The energy sector (.SPTTEN) fell 1.4%, while the materials sector (.GSPTTMT) dropped 0.7%, limiting broader market gains The yield on the US benchmark 10-year Treasury note dipped after hitting a 24-year high on Monday, while the yield on the Canadian 10-year government bond also edged lower, offering some respite to markets "I'd be focused more on interest rates, the 10-year yield in the United States, than I would be on energy prices, although they're related," said Matt Skipp, president at SW8 Asset Management "A moderating oil price seems to have the potential to lower yields, as investors worry less about inflation," Skipp added Concerns over persistent inflation and rising government debt, however, continue to keep bond and equity markets on edge Markets are pricing in at least one more quarter-point rate hike from the US Federal Reserve and a 25-basis-point increase from the Bank of Canada before year-end, according to LSEG compiled data

item.title: 日本の対米投資は中国依存度を低下、日中対話進展は期待＝米上院議員
item.description:
Kentaro Okasaka
[東京 ６日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
Kentaro Okasaka

[東京 ６日 ロイター] - 来日中のデービッド・マコーミック米上院議員は６日、都内で記者団の取材に応じ、日米両国が合意した５５００億ドル（約８７兆円）の対米投融資について、米国の製造業再生や日本の米市場へのアクセス獲得に加え、サプライチェーン（供給網）を中国から切り替えることで日米両国の対中依存度を低下させる効果があると述べた。

一方、マコーミック氏は中国が経済、軍事的に世界のリーダーの座を争う「敵対国」だとする一方、「共通点を探る努力は必要だ」と指摘。日本について「（世界有数の経済大国で）非常に重要な国だ。そして中国と同じ地域にあり、両国が対話を続けるのは理にかなったことだ」と話した。トランプ大統領と習近平国家主席の最近の会談に触れ、トランプ氏と高市早苗首相は「極めて緊密な関係にある」として米国の後押しで日中対話が進むことに期待を示した。

マコーミック氏は、日本製鉄が買収した米鉄鋼大手ＵＳスチールの本社があるペンシルベニア州選出。「ペンシルベニアにとっても米国にとっても、日本にとっても素晴らしい案件だと確信し、ホワイトハウスに行き、大統領執務室で大統領と会ってこの案件を支持するよう働きかけた」と振り返った。

item.title: ノーベル平和賞委、新たな協力を推進する人々に注目＝事務局長
item.description:
Nora Buli Gwladys Fouche
[オスロ ６日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
Nora Buli　Gwladys Fouche

[オスロ ６日 ロイター] - ノルウェー・ノーベル委員会(ノーベル平和賞委員会)のクリスティアン・ベルグ・ハルプビケン事務局長は、激動の中にある世界秩序の再編と、同賞の目的に沿った新たな協力の在り方を推進する人々を注視していると述べた。

同委員会は５人のメンバーで構成される。事務局長は候補に関する資料をまとめ、審議に参加するが、投票権はない。今年の受賞者発表は９日に行われる。

ハルプビケン氏は５日のインタビューで、世界が激動しているからといって、候補が不足しているわけでも、平和賞がその意義を失っているわけでもないと指摘。「賞そのものについては心配していないが、世界がどこへ向かっているのかについては懸念している」と付け加えた。

item.title: 「ニュートリノマン」にノーベル物理学賞、南極での国際研究事業主導
item.description: ［ストックホルム ６日 ロイター］ -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
［ストックホルム　６日　ロイター］ - スウェーデン王立科学アカデミーは６日、２０２６年のノーベル物理学賞を、ベルギー出身の素粒子物理学者フランシス・ハルツェン氏（米ウィスコンシン大学マディソン校教授）に授与すると発表した。授賞理由は「アイスキューブ・ニュートリノ観測所への決定的な貢献と、天体起源の高エネルギーニュートリノの発見」。

ハルツェン氏は、南極に設置した観測施設「アイスキューブ」での国際研究プロジェクトを主導した。

王立科学アカデミーのエバ・オルソン氏は記者会見で「（ニュートリノという）メッセンジャーは宇宙から情報を運んでくる」と述べ、「遠くの銀河への扉を開き、星が爆発する過程を教えてくれる」と語った。

ノーベル物理学委員会のマーク・ピアース委員長は声明で「ハルツェン氏は国際的な研究者・技術者チームを率い、素晴らしい観測装置をもたらしてくれた」とし、「その粘り強さと科学的な先見性が、新しい種類の天文学への道を開いた」とも語った。

ハルツェン氏は電話で記者会見に参加し、「自分がいかに幸運だったかを強調したい。このプロジェクトを始めた時、良いアイデアかもしれないとは誰もが思っていたが、うまくいくと考えた人はほとんどいなかった。私自身もそうだった」と語った。

ベルギーのデウェーフェル首相は、「宇宙の最も小さな現れを通じて、宇宙の最大の謎の解明にささげた人生」が認められたと称えた。

ニュートリノは地球や人体を跡形もなく通り抜け、物質とはごくまれにしか反応しないため、「幽霊粒子」と呼ばれることもある。ハルツェン氏は、南極点の氷を使えばニュートリノを追跡できることに気付いた。１９８８年、南極点でニュートリノの痕跡を捉えるという構想を初めて発表したが、プロジェクトの完成は２０１１年までかかった。

アイスキューブは、アムンゼン・スコット南極点基地の近くの地下深くにあり、５０００個を超えるセンサーが設置されている。

高エネルギーニュートリノは質量がほぼゼロで、他の粒子と違ってエネルギーを失ったり方向を変えたりしない。アイスキューブはその信号を待ち受け、経路をさかのぼって発生源を突き止めることを目指している。

ハルツェン氏は６日の会見で、自身の研究で宇宙について具体的に何が分かるかを語るのは尚早とし、「本当にわくわくするのは、その質問にまだ答えられないことだ。これは科学の入り口にすぎず、天文学としての成果はこれからだ」と語った。

米スミソニアン誌は１４年にハルツェン氏に「独創性賞」を贈った。その際、同氏を「ニュートリノマン」と呼び、「天文学の新時代の幕開けを告げる驚くべき実験」と称え、ハルツェン氏の半生を描いた漫画「一人の物理学者の宇宙探求はいかにして南極で飛躍したか（How OnePhysicist’s Pursuit of the Cosmos Took Off in Antarctica）」を掲載した。

item.title: 米国民、税金使う選挙広告に不信感＝ロイター／イプソス世論調査
item.description:
Trevor Hunnicutt Jason Lange
[ワシントン ６日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
Trevor Hunnicutt　Jason Lange

[ワシントン ６日 ロイター] - ロイター／イプソスが実施した世論調査によると、１１月の中間選挙を前にトランプ大統領が出演するテレビＣＭが放映される中、圧倒的多数の米国民が選挙の頃に大統領を起用したテレビＣＭに税金を使うのは不適切だと回答した。

５日に終了した６日間の世論調査によると、米国民の８６％、そして共和党員の５人に４人が、大統領や閣僚を起用した選挙関連のテレビ広告に税金を使うのは不適切だと考えていることが分かった。

倫理専門家や両党の議員は、中間選挙の数週間前に放映された「アメリカの黄金時代」を称える３つの全国放送広告を批判。議員らは公金がトランプ氏の政治的宣伝に使われているのではないかと疑問を呈しており、他の批判者らはこれらの広告が政府の宣伝活動や政治活動に関する規制に違反する可能性があると指摘している。

トランプ氏と側近らは、これらの広告は教育的かつ愛国的なものであり、特定の政治家候補を後押しする意図はないと述べている。

トランプ氏は５日夜、広告費は自ら支払うか、政治活動委員会（ＰＡＣ）の「ＭＡＧＡ」が集めた資金で賄うと表明した。

各広告の最後には、米国政府が費用を負担した旨が記載されている。

民主党議員らは独立した調査を求め、ホワイトハウスが広告放映のために国土安全保障省の資金２０００万ドルを流用したと主張している。

また、世論調査によると、回答者の約７１％が米首都ワシントンの総合文化施設ケネディ・センターの名称をトランプ氏の名前を含むものに変更することに反対している。共和党員でこの案を支持しているのはわずか４分の１だった。

さらに、共和党支持者の間では、一部の記者をホワイトハウスから締め出すことに賛成する人が多く、５７％が賛成。一方、民主党支持者と無党派層は圧倒的に反対した。全体として、回答者の６８％がこうしたやり方は不適切だと答えた。

調査はオンラインで全米規模で実施され、米国の成人４５０６人から回答を得た。

item.title: Exclusive-Anthropic's Amodei made $18 million last year, middle of the tech CEO pack
item.description: NEW YORK/BOSTON, October 6 : Dario Amodei made $18 million last year as CEO of Claude AI developer Anthropic, the company's IPO filing shows, putting him in the middle ranks of top executives at major technology firms in terms of compensation.Anthropic is preparing for an IPO as early as this fall that could
item.dc:creator: CNA
item.content:encoded:

Exclusive-Anthropic's Amodei made $18 million last year, middle of the tech CEO pack

Anthropic Co-Founder and CEO Dario Amodei speaks at Dreamforce 2026 summit in San Francisco, California, U.S., September 15, 2026. REUTERS/Carlos Barria

FILE PHOTO: Anthropic logo, a keyboard, and a robotic hand in this illustration taken June 5, 2026. REUTERS/Dado Ruvic/Illustration/File Photo

FAST

NEW YORK/BOSTON, October 6 : Dario Amodei made $18 million last year as CEO of Claude AI developer Anthropic, the company's IPO filing shows, putting him in the middle ranks of top executives at major technology firms in terms of compensation. Anthropic is preparing for an IPO as early as this fall that could value it at more than $2 trillion, according to its IPO prospectus seen by Reuters. Amodei's pay last year puts him above CEOs at Alphabet and Amazon, but behind those at Oracle and Nvidia.  Amodei's pay leans heavily towards stock and other sorts of compensation, suggesting that like many other tech founders, his yearly salary will account for just a fraction of his wealth. Dario Amodei and his sister, Anthropic President Daniela Amodei, each had their annual salaries doubled this past July to $1.4 million. Stock and options awards made up the bulk of their packages in 2025, with Daniela Amodei receiving a total of $16.4 million last year.

Anthropic's board this year granted the pair the promise of further equity in the form of restricted stock units, which promise a future payout if certain conditions are met. Some of that is tied to their remaining at the company, and some of it is tied to the IPO. Chief Financial Officer Krishna Rao earned $720,250 last year. He was granted options to buy 1.4 million shares when he was hired in 2024, and exercised options worth $385,285 in 2025. An Anthropic spokesperson declined to comment on the figures. MIDDLE OF THE PACK The rise in US CEO pay in recent years has far outpaced the gains for the average worker, a dynamic critics worry could be exacerbated by AI's widespread adoption. S&P 500 CEO average annual compensation rose 21 per cent to $22.8 million last year, and that does not include the extraordinary case of Tesla's Elon Musk and his $158 billion restricted stock plan, according to the AFL-CIO. Courtney Yu, director of research for executive compensation data firm Equilar, said Amodei's $18 million haul "seems on the lower end for a company valued at $2 trillion, but it will be interesting to see how that changes once the company goes public" and his full ownership stake is shown. With six other co-founders, Amodei may wind up getting a lesser share of the wealth created by the IPO compared with other major tech CEOs, Yu added. Top executives at AI-focused tech firms earned amounts that varied widely in 2025, based on SEC filings. At the high end, Oracle co-CEO Clayton Magouyrk earned $627.5 million, while the lowest was the $54,080 paid to Musk as CEO of SpaceX, before it went public. SpaceX has also promised super-voting restricted shares to Musk, already the world's richest person, if the company's market value grows to $7.5 trillion and the firm puts 1 million people on Mars. Other giant companies pay less on a year-by-year basis, with executives benefiting from enormous stock ownership while having only salary and security costs reflected in annual filings.  For instance, Alphabet CEO Sundar Pichai made $10.9 million in 2025, including $8.8 million for personal security "due to Sundar's significant public profile." By "compensation actually paid," Pichai earned $213.9 million last year, which among other things reflects the change in value of his unvested shares.  Amazon CEO Andrew Jassy made $2.1 million in 2025, a disclosure said, mainly reflecting travel and security. On an "actually paid" basis, Jassy received $13.2 million.  LIVING OFF THE STOCK Equilar's Yu said the disclosures show how these executives don't need to worry about year-by-year pay. "Founder CEOs typically own enough equity that when the company does well and the stock prices increases they can just live off the wealth of the equity they already own, and typically don't take in a lot in annual compensation," Yu said. Anthropic said in the filing it offered a mix of salary, equity awards and other benefits. The S-1 statement seen by Reuters does not describe the founders' share of ownership in the company, which could be worth billions of dollars, depending on the final terms and valuation of the IPO. The Amodei siblings and their fellow co-founders pledged in the IPO filing to dedicate 80 per cent of their personal Anthropic equity to charitable causes. Asked about the 80 per cent figure Monday, an Anthropic spokesperson noted an essay Dario Amodei posted earlier this year, where he wrote that wealthy individuals have an obligation to help address problems stemming from AI adoption, and decried that many wealthy people, particularly in the tech industry, "have recently adopted a cynical and nihilistic attitude that philanthropy is inevitably fraudulent or useless."

Source: Reuters

item.title: アンソロピックＣＥＯ、25年報酬1800万ドル 業界中位
item.description:
Echo Wang Ross Kerber Isla Binnie
[ニューヨーク／ボストン ６日 ロイター] - 人...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
アンソロピックＣＥＯ、25年報酬1800万ドル　業界中位 10/6 19:01 配信

写真はアントロピックのロゴとキーボード、ロボットの手のイメージ。6月5日撮影。REUTERS/Dado Ruvic

Echo Wang　Ross Kerber　Isla Binnie

[ニューヨーク／ボストン ６日 ロイター] - 人工知能（ＡＩ）「クロード」を開発するアンソロピックのダリオ・アモデイ最高経営責任者（ＣＥＯ）の２０２５年の報酬は１８００万ドルだった。同社の新規株式公開（ＩＰＯ）申請書類で明らかになった。大手テクノロジー企業の経営トップの中では中位に位置する。

ロイターが確認したＩＰＯ目論見書によると、アンソロピックは早ければ今秋の上場を準備しており、企業価値は２兆ドルを超える可能性がある。アモデイ氏の２５年の報酬は、アルファベットやアマゾン・ドット・コムのＣＥＯを上回る一方、オラクルやエヌビディアのＣＥＯには及ばなかった。

アモデイ氏の報酬は株式などに大きく偏っており、他の多くのテクノロジー企業創業者と同様、年間給与が資産に占める割合はごく一部にとどまるとみられる。

アモデイ氏と妹のダニエラ・アモデイ社長の年間給与は、７月にそれぞれ２倍の１４０万ドルに引き上げられた。２５年の報酬は両氏とも株式とストックオプション（自社株購入権）が大半を占め、ダニエラ氏の報酬総額は１６４０万ドルだった。

アンソロピックの取締役会は今年、両氏に対し譲渡制限付き株式ユニット（ＲＳＵ）の形で追加の株式を付与することを約束した。ＲＳＵは一定の条件を満たした場合に将来支払われる仕組みで、一部は在籍継続、一部はＩＰＯに連動している。

アンソロピックの広報担当者は、これらの数字についてコメントを控えた。

＜大手テクノロジー企業の中では中位＞

米労働総同盟産別会議（ＡＦＬ─ＣＩＯ）によると、Ｓ＆Ｐ５００種指数構成企業のＣＥＯの平均年間報酬は２５年に２１％増の２２８０万ドルとなった。この数字には、テスラのイーロン・マスクＣＥＯに対する１５８０億ドルの譲渡制限付き株式報酬という例外的な事例は含まれていない。

役員報酬データ会社エクイラーの調査責任者コートニー・ユー氏は、アモデイ氏の１８００万ドルという報酬について「企業価値が２兆ドルの会社としては低い方に見える」とした上で、上場して同氏の保有株式の全容が明らかになった後、どう変わるかは興味深いと述べた。他に６人の共同創業者がいるため、アモデイ氏がＩＰＯによって生み出される富から得る取り分は、他の大手テクノロジー企業のＣＥＯより小さくなる可能性があるとした。

米証券取引委員会（ＳＥＣ）への提出書類によると、ＡＩに注力するテクノロジー企業の経営トップの２５年報酬には大きな開きがあった。高額な例ではオラクルのクレイトン・マグワイク共同ＣＥＯが６億２７５０万ドルを受け取った。一方、最低だったのは、上場前のスペースＸのＣＥＯとしてマスク氏に支払われた５万４０８０ドルだった。スペースＸは、同社の時価総額が７兆５０００億ドルに達し、火星に１００万人を送り込んだ場合、マスク氏に対し、強力な議決権を持つ譲渡制限付き株式を付与することも約束している。

他の巨大企業では、経営幹部が巨額の保有株式から恩恵を受ける一方、年次開示には給与や警備費用のみが計上されるため、年間の報酬額は比較的少ない。

例えば、アルファベットのスンダー・ピチャイＣＥＯの２５年の報酬は１０９０万ドルだった。このうち８８０万ドルは「スンダー氏の社会的な知名度の高さを踏まえた」身辺警護費用だった。一方、未確定の株式報酬の価値変動などを反映する「実際に支払われた報酬」という開示上の指標では、２億１３９０万ドルだった。

item.title: シチズン、約10万人の顧客情報流出の恐れ 委託先企業に不正アクセス
item.description: [東京 ６日 ロイター] - シチズン時計は６日、委託先企業のサーバーが不正アクセスを受け、保存されていた約１０万人...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
シチズン、約10万人の顧客情報流出の恐れ　委託先企業に不正アクセス 10/6 18:56 配信

写真はバイナリーコードと「データ流出」の文字、南京錠とパソコンを操作する人々のイメージ。2022年2月撮影。REUTERS/Dado Ruvic

[東京 ６日 ロイター] - シチズン時計は６日、委託先企業のサーバーが不正アクセスを受け、保存されていた約１０万人の顧客情報が流出した可能性があると発表した。二次被害は確認されていないという。

シチズンが顧客からの問い合わせ受付業務を委託していたスカラコミュニケーションズによると、１０月２日夜から３日朝にかけて不正アクセスが発生。 約１０万人の氏名、住所、電話番号、メールアドレスなどが流出した可能性があるという。問い合わせ内容欄に銀行口座やクレジットカード情報などを記載していた場合は漏えいした可能性があるとしている。

対象はシチズン、ブローバ、フレデリック・コンスタントの各ブランドのホームページ。シチズン本体への不正アクセスは確認されていないという。

item.title: Francis Halzen wins Nobel physics prize for Antarctic 'ghost particle' hunt
item.description: STOCKHOLM: The Belgian-American Francis Halzen won the 2026 Nobel Prize in Physics for his work creating an Antarctic observatory of ice to detect high-energy neutrinos, elusive subatomic particles that can reveal otherwise inaccessible information about the cosmos.Halzen, 82, realised that pristine ice at th

Francis Halzen wins Nobel physics prize for Antarctic 'ghost particle' hunt

Eva Olsson, Ellen Moons, and Mark Pearce sit as they announce Francis Halzen as the recipient of the 2026 Nobel Prize in Physics during a press conference at the Royal Swedish Academy of Sciences in Stockholm, Sweden, Oct 6, 2026. (Photo: TT News Agency/Christine Olsson via REUTERS)

FAST

STOCKHOLM: The Belgian-American Francis Halzen won the 2026 Nobel Prize in Physics for his work creating an Antarctic observatory of ice to detect high-energy neutrinos, elusive subatomic particles that can reveal otherwise inaccessible information about the cosmos. Halzen, 82, realised that pristine ice at the South Pole could be used to track such neutrinos, sometimes known as "ghost particles" for the way they pass through the Earth without a trace, only interacting with matter extremely rarely. "The messengers bring information from the cosmos," Eva Olsson, of the Royal Swedish Academy of Sciences, told a press conference. "They open the door to distant galaxies and tell us about the processes of exploding stars." HALZEN HAILED FOR DETECTING "MESSENGERS FROM THE COSMOS" The interactions registered by the IceCube observatory provide information about how high-energy neutrinos are created and may even reveal previously unknown phenomena, the Academy said.

In 2014, the US-based Smithsonian magazine dubbed Halzen "Neutrino Man" when giving him one of its Ingenuity Awards, acclaiming him for an "amazing experiment (that) heralds the beginning of a new era in astronomy". It even published a comic illustrating his life: "How One Physicist’s Pursuit of the Cosmos Took Off in Antarctica". The observatory - in effect a telescope that shows neutrinos instead of light - is set in a cubic kilometre of Antarctic ice, which extends to a depth of 2,500 metres below the surface near the Amundsen-Scott South Pole Station. More than 5,000 sensors await blips from the nearly massless high-energy neutrinos, which unlike other particles do not lose energy or change direction, in the hope of tracing their paths back to exploding stars, gamma-ray bursts, and cataclysmic phenomena involving black holes and neutron stars. They can expect to register about one per day. Halzen, a professor at the University of Wisconsin–Madison in the United States, first presented his idea in 1988 for capturing neutrino traces at the South Pole, but the project was not completed until 2011. "I have to emphasise how lucky I was because, when we started this project, everybody realised this was maybe a good idea, but very few thought it would work, including myself," Halzen told the press conference by telephone. Neutrinos are electrically neutral, undisturbed by any magnetic field, which means that, in contrast to electromagnetic waves such as visible light, the direction from which they arrive points directly back to their source.

Related:

Medicine Nobel goes to US-German trio for pioneering light-based control of cells

FRUITS OF HALZEN'S RESEARCH YET TO COME The observatory has determined that high-energy neutrinos originate within but also far outside our own Milky Way galaxy, setting in motion an interstellar quest to find the objects and processes that create them. Through the long winter at the South Pole, when bringing anything in or out is difficult as temperatures below minus 50°C (minus 58 Fahrenheit) preclude even aircraft landing, a skeleton crew of "winterovers" has to maintain the observatory. The station, home to many other activities, can house as many as 150 people and has an industrial kitchen, dining room, gym and even a greenhouse. Last week it celebrated the sun's return above the horizon after six months of night with a six-hole ice-golf tournament. An extension, IceCube-Gen2, encompassing 8 cubic kilometres of ice, is planned to become operational in 2033 and will be able to detect 10 times as many neutrinos, including much weaker ones. Halzen said the main fruits of his work were yet to be seen and that it was too early to say exactly what it could reveal about the universe. "The real excitement is that I cannot answer that question yet," he said. "This is just an introduction to the science, the astronomy is still to come." WINNERS FROM EINSTEIN TO BOHR AND THE CURIES Belgian Prime Minister Bart De Wever congratulated Halzen on the recognition of "a life dedicated to unraveling the greatest secrets of the cosmos through its most minuscule manifestations". The physics laureate receives an award of 12 million Swedish crowns (US$1.2 million). Past winners include several other neutrino research pioneers, for instance Japan's Takaaki Kajita and Arthur McDonald from Canada in 2015. The Nobel Prizes were established under the will of Swedish inventor and entrepreneur Alfred Nobel, whose fortune was built in part on the invention of dynamite. Physics was prominent in Nobel's will and the prize remains one of the discipline's highest distinctions. Over the decades, it has recognised discoveries that have fundamentally reshaped humanity's understanding of the universe. Among past laureates are some of the most celebrated figures in science, including Albert Einstein, Marie and Pierre Curie, Max Planck and Niels Bohr, whose work helped establish the foundations of modern physics. The prize is presented in Stockholm on Dec 10, the anniversary of Nobel's death.

Source: Reuters/fh

UK online retailer ASOS shares drop on reports of cybersecurity breach

People walk past the ASOS pop-up store in London on Nov 12, 2025. (Photo: Reuters/Hannah McKay)

06 Oct 2026 05:51PM (Updated: 06 Oct 2026 08:07PM)

FAST

Shares in ASOS dropped more than 11 per cent on Tuesday (Oct 6) after media reports said customers of the British online fashion retailer received push notifications saying the company was hacked. Reuters could not immediately verify the reports. An ASOS spokesperson said it was aware of the reports but did not confirm or comment further.   The notification - addressed to ASOS' data protection officer and IT department - read, "we have fully compromised the Snowflake instance. Engage with us, or we will leak it," according to the reports. "Snowflake is a massive cloud database where retailers typically store sensitive customer information, a real worry if cyber criminals have indeed accessed it as they claim," said Dray Agha, senior manager of security operations at cybersecurity platform Huntress. British companies and institutions have been increasingly hit by aggressive and regular cyber and ransomware attacks in recent years. The British Library, a blood testing service, the London Underground, Marks & Spencer, the Co-op and Jaguar Land Rover are some of the companies that have suffered months of disruption due to such breaches. "The push notification suggests attackers have breached the systems controlling the ASOS mobile app also," Agha said. "Sending a ransom demand directly to consumer devices is an aggressive extortion tactic designed to force the business into a quick negotiation." ASOS shares were up more than 60 per cent so far this year. The company has been divesting assets and last month provided an upbeat profit forecast for fiscal 2026.

Related:

UK plans tougher laws to protect public services from cyberattacks

Source: Reuters/ia

item.title: Californians blast Trump remark that Iran could 'take out' Los Angeles, San Diego
item.description: President Donald Trump suggested to a crowd of his supporters in Nebraska that Iran could "take out" a major US city like Los Angeles or San Diego, drawing a swift rebuke from California's Democratic leaders and some fellow Republicans.
item.dc:creator: Steve Gorman, Bo Erickson
item.content:encoded: President Donald Trump suggested to a crowd of his supporters in Nebraska that Iran could "take out" a major US city like Los Angeles or San Diego, drawing a swift rebuke from California's Democratic leaders and some fellow Republicans. Trump, speaking at a [USN:L1N45R0ZC TEXT:"political rally"] in the state's farm belt on Monday, discussed American wartime economic sacrifices and said he was determined to "see a tremendous victory, because it verifies all the things we did." "And again, remember, with the war, it's just artificial, it's a little bit high, it's a small price to pay," he told the crowd in Grand Island, Nebraska, apparently referring to rising prices of fuel, fertilizer and other products attributed to energy market disruptions from the war. "It's a small price to pay for keeping the world safe, for keeping our country safe. They could take out a city. Let 'em take out Los Angeles, let 'em take out San Diego. This is a very small price to pay, and it's going to be over with very soon," he said. "It's essentially almost over with," Trump went on. "But it's going to end very soon, and it's going to end one way or the other." On Tuesday, the White House dismissed criticism of the remark. "The media freakout over President Trump’s comments is not rooted in reality. He was clearly stating U.S. cities would have been threatened if a nuclear Iran hadn't been stopped," White House Director of Communications Steven Cheung said in a social media post. "America is safer because of the President. Iran has no nuclear, no navy, no air force, and no money." Trump has shrugged off cost-of-living concerns stemming from the Iran conflict before, and he previously downplayed his concerns about the potential for Iran or its allies to launch an attack on US soil. EARLY VOTING UNDERWAY IN CALIFORNIA The comment in rural Nebraska, a state Trump won with more than 55% of the vote in the 2024 presidential election, targeted Democratic-run cities in California, a solidly Democratic state the president often criticizes. Monday's comments prompted a backlash from California officials. California Governor Gavin Newsom, a Democrat, denounced the Republican president as "deranged and dangerous." "After sending the National Guard and Marines to occupy California, Donald Trump is now saying our foreign enemies should 'take out' Los Angeles and San Diego," he wrote on X. Newsom, who has positioned himself as a major political foil to Trump and is seen as a potential 2028 presidential candidate, juxtaposed a video clip of Trump in Nebraska with mention of the president's previous rhetoric to justify deploying US military troops to Los Angeles and other cities to fight crime and enforce immigration. California's early voting for the November midterm elections started on Monday. The president's Republican Party has hoped to win more races in the state in recent years, including this year's gubernatorial election. Newsom championed the redrawing of California's [USN:S0N3WN09U TEXT:"congressional map"] last year to favor Democrats in this year's election after Trump pushed for conservative-led Texas to [USN:L1N3TX13Y TEXT:"redraw its map"] to boost Republicans. One of the Republicans running in a competitive race in a redrawn California district near San Diego, Jim Desmond, distanced himself from Trump's remarks. "I vehemently disagree with President Trump’s comments. America must stand up to Iran and defend our interests, but the first responsibility of our Commander in Chief is to protect the American people and our homeland," he wrote on X. "No American city is expendable, and no American family should ever be treated as collateral damage." Los Angeles Mayor Karen Bass, a Democrat and former member of Congress, likewise chided Trump for his comments. "The president of the United States suggested that a foreign government attack Los Angeles. His statements against our city are dangerous and could potentially compromise our safety," Bass said in a statement. Los Angeles and San Diego rank as the largest and second-largest cities in California by population. More than 115,000 activity-duty service members are also stationed in San Diego, including Naval Base San Diego, the largest on the United States' west coast. "My constituents — including many active duty service members, veterans, and their families — are not acceptable collateral damage in Trump’s stupid war," US Representative Sara Jacobs, a Democrat, said in a social media post.

item.title: 英国経済、高インフレが定着＝中銀のマン委員
item.description: [ロンドン ６日 ロイター] - イングランド銀行（英中央銀行）金融政策委員会（ＭＰＣ）のキャサリン・マン委員は６日...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
英国経済、高インフレが定着＝中銀のマン委員 10/6 18:49 配信

写真はイングランド銀行（英中央銀行）金融政策委員会（ＭＰＣ）のキャサリン・マン委員。2023年1月、英マンチェスターで撮影。REUTERS/Phil Noble

[ロンドン ６日 ロイター] - イングランド銀行（英中央銀行）金融政策委員会（ＭＰＣ）のキャサリン・マン委員は６日、２％の目標を上回るインフレが英国経済に定着してしまったようだと述べた。

経済助言会社ＴＳロンバードが主催した会議で「私がこの職に就いて以来、インフレ率は一貫して目標を大幅に上回ってきた。インフレは定着してしまった」と語った。

また、賃金交渉が活発化する年末年始ごろにインフレ率が４％に達する見通しであることに特に懸念を示した。

マン氏は、英国の経済需要は力強いとは思えないものの、ポジティブとの見解を示した。

さらに、最近の労働生産性データの上方改定が労働時間の下方改定によるものだったことに触れ、これが将来的にインフレを伴わない成長を実現する経済の能力を制限する可能性があるとの見解を示した。

マン氏は７月以来、政策金利を０．２５ポイント引き上げて４％とする案に賛成票を投じる少数派の一員となっている。

ロイター 関連ニュース 焦点：債務膨張の先進国に金融危機の芽、最も懸念される米・伊・英 アングル：英新財務相、実務手腕に一定評価も支出拡大・増税不安消えず アングル：英国経済、ＥＵ離脱から10年の軌跡 アングル：ブレグジット10年、英ＥＵの溝なお深く　極右台頭も重し 焦点：ＥＵ離脱から10年、苦闘続く英輸出企業　非離脱シナリオより低成長の予測 最終更新: 10/6(火) 19:36 ロイター

item.title: ロシアのペスト研究所職員死亡、新たな感染の兆候なし＝ＷＨＯ
item.description: ［ジュネーブ ６日 ロイター］ -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
［ジュネーブ　６日　ロイター］ - 世界保健機関（ＷＨＯ）は６日、ロシアのイルクーツクにあるペスト研究所で女性職員が死亡した事案について、ロシア当局が同日、当地でペストの症例は確認されていないとＷＨＯに報告したと明らかにした。

ＷＨＯのリンドマイヤー報道官が、ＷＨＯの照会に対するロシア側の公式回答を発表した。公式回答は「イルクーツク市において、この危険な疾患の症例は記録されていない」と表明。死亡した職員と接触した人々を特定し、危険な感染性病原体の検査結果は陰性だったとした。

検査結果について、死亡した職員に対しても検査を実施したのか、また職員についてペストの可能性を排除できたのか、ロイターは今のところ確認できていない。ジュネーブの国連ロシア代表部はコメント要請に応じていない。

Bird said the refinery was using Saudi Aramco's listing as a benchmark for the IPO and expected to "smash that" target.

item.description: [ヘルシンキ ６日 ロイター] - 欧州中央銀行（ＥＣＢ）理事会メンバーのレーン・フィンランド中銀総裁は６日、最近...

item.content:encoded:
ＥＣＢ安全網、議論の時期ではない＝フィンランド中銀総裁 10/6 18:36 配信

写真は欧州中央銀行（ECB）本部ビルの外に掲げられたロゴ。2018年4月、フランクフルトで撮影。REUTERS/Kai Pfaffenbach

[ヘルシンキ ６日 ロイター] - 欧州中央銀行（ＥＣＢ）理事会メンバーのレーン・フィンランド中銀総裁は６日、最近の債券利回り上昇にもかかわらず、ユーロ圏の金融政策伝達メカニズムは適切に機能しているとし、ＥＣＢのセーフティーネット（安全網）について議論する時期ではないと述べた。

ＥＣＢがフランス債券市場への支援を検討すべきかとの問いに、フランス銀行（中銀）のムーラン総裁の見解に「全面的に同意する」と回答。そのような支援の議論は時宜を得ておらず、各国は自国の財政の持続可能性を確保しなければならないとの考えを示した。

item.title: アジア株式市場サマリー：引け（16日）
item.description: 香港株式市場は海外市場に追随して堅調。製薬株やハイテク株が上昇した。 ハンセン指数は１％高。ハンセン中国株指数は１...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
アジア株式市場サマリー：引け（16日） 10/6 18:34 配信

香港株式市場は海外市場に追随して堅調。製薬株やハイテク株が上昇した。    ハンセン指数は１％高。ハンセン中国株指数は１％近く上昇した。    ハンセン・バイオテック指数は３．２%上昇し、ハンセン・テック指数は０．９%上昇した。    HSBC Qianhaiの中国ヘルスケア調査責任者リンダ・シュー氏はリポートで「２０２６年には主要な製薬企業のほとんどが堅調な成長を遂げると予想している」と記した。    半面、主要な不動産開発会社の株価は下落し、新鴻基地産（サンフンカイ・プロパティーズ）は０．６％安、長江実業集団（ＣＫアセット・ホールディングス）は０．３％安となった。    ＵＯＢケイヒアンは「（住宅）価格は２０２６年を通じてもみ合いが続くと予想している」と指摘した。    新世界発展（ニューワールド・デベロップメント）３．５％安。２７年および２８年に満期を迎える一部社債について、３２年に満期を迎える新たな担保付社債とスワップする債務交換オファーを発表した。    中国本土の金融市場は国慶節（建国記念日）の連休で７日まで休場。取引は８日に再開する。

休場明けのソウル株式市場は下落。今週発表されるサムスン電子の決算を控え、半導体株が売られた。

未来アセット証券のアナリスト、ソ・サンヨン氏は「メモリー半導体価格の継続的な上昇を背景にサムスン電子の決算は良好な内容になるとみられるが、債券利回りの高止まりが相場全般の重しとなっている」と指摘した。

半導体のサムスン電子は１．４５％安、同業のＳＫハイニックスは３．６９％下落した。

電池メーカーのＬＧエネルギーソリューションが５．１２％上昇。現代自動車は０．４３％高、傘下の起亜は０．２７％安だった。

売買された９１８銘柄のうち、値上がりは４２５、値下がりは４６１。

外国人投資家は差し引き１兆８０００億ウォン（１３億４０００万ドル）の売り越し。

シドニー株式市場は３営業日続伸して取引を終えた。銅価格の上昇を背景に主力鉱山株が買われたほか、原油安でインフレ懸念が和らいだ。

金融株指数は０．７％上昇し、３営業日続伸。４大銀行は全て上昇し、上昇率は０．６─０．８％だった。不動産株指数は１．１％上昇し、４営業日ぶりに反発した。センター・グループは２．７％、ＧＰＴグループは２．３％それぞれ上昇した。

鉱業株指数は銅価格の上昇を受けて０．９％上昇した。業界大手のＢＨＰグループは１．６％高となり、約１カ月ぶりの高値を付けた。ハイテク株指数は３％近く下落し、１カ月余りで最大の下落率を記録した。ワイズテック・グローバルは２．５％下落し、下げを主導した。

item.title: 英建設ＰＭＩ、9月46.1に改善 新規受注は引き続き低迷
item.description:
David Milliken
[ロンドン ６日 ロイター] - Ｓ＆Ｐグローバルが６日発表した英国の９月の建設業購買担...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
英建設ＰＭＩ、9月46.1に改善　新規受注は引き続き低迷 10/6 18:31 配信

写真は6月9日、ロンドンの建設現場で撮影。REUTERS/Chris J. Ratcliffe

David Milliken

[ロンドン ６日 ロイター] - Ｓ＆Ｐグローバルが６日発表した英国の９月の建設業購買担当者景気指数（ＰＭＩ）は４６．１だった。８月の４４．３から改善したものの、好不況の分かれ目である５０を引き続き下回った。ただ落ち込みは１月以降で最も穏やかだった。

英建設業ＰＭＩは２０２５年１月から５０を下回っている。

Ｓ＆Ｐグローバル・マーケット・インテリジェンスの経済ディレクター、ティム・ムーア氏は「９月の新規受注は相対的に低迷した。建設企業は営業から受注までの期間が長期化しており、顧客が大型プロジェクトの意思決定を先送りにしていると指摘した」と述べた。

・新規受注指数は４５．９で、前月の４７．７から低下し３カ月ぶりの低水準。

・投入価格の上昇率は２月のイラン戦争勃発以来、最も緩やかなペースとなった。ただしムーア氏は、エネルギーコストの上昇を踏まえると、この傾向が続く可能性は低いと述べた。

・今後の活動見通しは５月以来で最も弱かった。

・部門別では住宅建設が引き続き最も低調で、土木工事がこれに続いた。一方、商業施設は小幅な低下にとどまった。

・サービス、製造業、建設業のＰＭＩデータを含む全セクターＰＭＩは５１．５で前月の５１．８から低下し、３カ月ぶりの低水準。

item.title: Sterling slips from three-month high against euro as traders watch French bonds
item.description: The pound eased against the euro on Tuesday as French bonds rallied from the previous session's fall that helped propel sterling to an almost three-month high.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: The pound eased against the euro on Tuesday as French bonds rallied from the previous session's fall that helped propel sterling to an almost three-month high. The euro [USN:L6N45S0D2 TEXT:"fell sharply"] on Monday as investors worried that a dramatic fall in French bonds due to concerns about public debt and a looming election was spreading to other markets such as Italy. Yet French bonds rose on Tuesday, pushing yields lower and helping currency markets stabilise. The euro was last up 0.1% at 84.88 pence after hitting an almost three-month low of 84.61 pence on Monday following seven straight sessions of declines. Sterling was around 0.1% higher against the dollar at $1.322. Aside from euro zone bond markets, the focus for UK traders is likely to be on Bank of England officials this week. Catherine Mann, who voted to raise rates in July and September, [USN:S8N42Q0DO TEXT:"said on Tuesday"] that inflation has become embedded in the UK. Governor Andrew Bailey is among a handful of BoE policymakers speaking on Thursday. The central bank has so far held rates during the Iran war-driven spike in energy costs but traders currently price in around an 80% chance of a rate hike in November and around 100 basis points of total monetary tightening by the end of next year. Later this month, the British budget could cause swings in sterling and domestic bond markets. [USN:L6N45S0EX TEXT:"Morgan Stanley"] on Tuesday said the pound appears to be pricing in too little fiscal risk ahead of the budget on October 28 and recommended betting on sterling to fall, saying it was targeting a drop to $1.285. "With so many medium-term decisions yet to be made, a challenging tax-hiking arithmetic and relatively benign expectations from market participants around this Budget — at least per our conversations — we see more pronounced downside than upside risks," the bank's strategists wrote in a research note.

item.title: 東エルサレムの英領事館、閉鎖ならイスラエル外交官追放も＝関係筋
item.description:
Alexander Cornwell
[テルアビブ ６日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
Alexander Cornwell

[テルアビブ ６日 ロイター] - イスラエル入植地を対象とした制裁を巡る対立で、イスラエルが今週、東エルサレムにある英国領事館の閉鎖命令を実行した場合、英国は対抗措置としてイスラエルの外交官を追放する可能性が高い。関係筋４人が明らかにした。

パレスチナ自治区ヨルダン川西岸の入植地で生産された製品の輸入を禁止する方針を英国が発表したことを受け、イスラエルは先月、同領事館を３０日以内に閉鎖し、外交官を同市から退去させるよう命じた。

関係筋によると、８日が領事館閉鎖の期限となる。同領事館に勤務する約３０人の英国人外交官とその家族が影響を受ける。

関係筋は領事館が閉鎖されれば、英国は対抗措置として、駐英イスラエル大使館から同程度の人数を追放する可能性が高いと述べた。

領事館は東エルサレムのシェイクジャラ地区にあり、エルサレム市内やヨルダン川西岸、ガザ地区のパレスチナ人との関係窓口を務めるほか、パレスチナ人向けの領事業務も行っている。

別の関係筋２人によると、イスラエル政府に決定を撤回させるため、英国は欧州各国に対し、この問題をイスラエル側に提起するよう求めた。

ROME, Oct 6 : Italy's antitrust authority said on Tuesday it had opened an investigation into AI music startup Suno, saying some clauses in its terms of service may be unfair to consumers. • Suno was not immediately available for comment • Suno's terms could create a significant imbalance in the rights and obligations of users, the watchdog said • They give Suno "broad discretion" to unilaterally modify its contract, service and subscription prices without having to provide any justification, it added in a statement

item.title: ベインとＧＩＣ、人事システムＷＨＩの上場・売却を検討 企業価値5000億円超目指す＝関係者
item.description:
Miho Uranaka Yantoultra Ngui
[東京 ６日 ロイター] - 米投資会社ベインキャピタルとシ...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
ベインとＧＩＣ、人事システムＷＨＩの上場・売却を検討　企業価値5000億円超目指す＝関係者 10/6 18:08 配信

写真は米投資会社ベインキャピタルのロゴイメージ。2月4日撮影。REUTERS/Dado Ruvic

Miho Uranaka　Yantoultra Ngui

[東京 ６日 ロイター] - 米投資会社ベインキャピタルとシンガポール政府系ファンドのＧＩＣが、人事管理システムを手がけるＷＨＩホールディングス（東京都港区）について、新規株式公開（ＩＰＯ）または第三者への売却を検討しており、５０００億円超の企業価値を目指していることが分かった。事情に詳しい関係者２人が明らかにした。

関係者によると、両社は、このプロセスの一環として、アドバイザーや潜在的な買い手、投資家への打診を始めている。選択肢の一つとして日本市場への上場が検討されているほか、事業会社や他のファンドなどへの売却も検討しているという。

協議は初期段階にあり、最終的な決定は下されていない。ベインとＧＩＣは最終的に保有を継続する可能性もあるという。

ベインとＧＩＣはコメントを控えた。ＷＨＩのコメントは現時点で得られていない。

ベインは２０１９年、ワークスアプリケーションズ（同千代田区）から人事ソフト事業を取得し、ＷＨＩを発足させた。取得額は公表されていない。２０２３年３月にはＧＩＣがＷＨＩに共同出資し、両社は共同支配株主となった。

ＷＨＩ傘下の中核事業会社ワークスヒューマンインテリジェンスは、人事管理、給与計算、勤怠管理、タレントマネジメントなどの機能を備えた大企業向け人事システム「ＣＯＭＰＡＮＹ」の開発・販売・サポートを手掛ける。ＷＨＩホールディングスのホームページによると、国内大手法人約１２００グループで利用されている。

item.title: ルペン氏、歳出削減目標1400億ユーロ 仏大統領選にらみ財政構想
item.description: [パリ ６日 ロイター] - フランスの極右政党「国民連合（ＲＮ）」のマリーヌ・ルペン氏は６日、来年の大統領選挙を見据え...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
ルペン氏、歳出削減目標1400億ユーロ　仏大統領選にらみ財政構想 10/6 18:00 配信

写真は極右政党「国民連合（ＲＮ）」 のマリーヌ・ルペン氏。10月6日、パリで撮影。REUTERS/Sarah Meyssonnier

[パリ ６日 ロイター] - フランスの極右政党「国民連合（ＲＮ）」のマリーヌ・ルペン氏は６日、来年の大統領選挙を見据えて、財政運営方針を示した。同国の債務が雪だるま式に膨らむ危機に瀕していると指摘し、歳出削減規模を従来方針から拡大した。

＜就任後１８カ月以内に基礎的財政収支均衡＞

ルペン氏は、大統領に就任した場合、就任後１８カ月以内に基礎的財政収支を均衡させると述べた。

財政赤字の対国内総生産（ＧＤＰ）比率を２０３０年までに３％未満にし、任期最終年の３２年までに２．５％未満に引き下げるとした。

公的債務は２７年のＧＤＰ比約１２１％から３２年までに１１２％に下げる。

歳出は、３２年までに、少なくとも３００億ユーロの減税分を差し引いて１４００億ユーロ（１５７０億ドル）削減する。任期終了までに公的支出をＧＤＰ比５０％未満に下げるとした。

財政の混乱は選挙戦の最大の争点になっている。

ルペン氏は、現在ＧＤＰ比１１９％の公的債務が６０％に下がるまで、財政赤字を毎年少なくとも０．５ポイント減らすことを義務付ける「黄金律」を国民投票にかけ、財政規律を憲法に明記したいと述べた。

また欧州連合（ＥＵ）の予算協議でフランスの純拠出額を５０億ユーロ（５６億１０００万ドル）に減らすよう求める考えを示した。

さらに、数週間以内にフランスの年金制度に関する提案を行うと表明した。節税スキームを利用して納税額を圧縮している多国籍企業への対策として、売上高に占めるフランス国内での売上高の割合に基づいて課税する方針を示した。

＜金利上昇巡りＥＣＢと協議＞

同氏は、フランスが財政を再び管理できるようになった段階で、借り入れコストを引き下げるための介入について欧州中央銀行（ＥＣＢ）と協議すべきだと述べた。

ＥＣＢには、市場の圧力に直面したユーロ加盟国の国債を、健全な経済政策の維持を条件に買い入れる伝達保護措置（ＴＰＩ）という制度がある。レスキュール経済・財務相は６日、同国の国債市場の混乱について、資金調達環境の安定に向けてＴＰＩの活用を検討する段階には至っていないとの認識を示した。

item.title: 英、米メタを調査 インスタの「インスタンツ」機能巡り
item.description: ［６日 ロイター］ - 英情報通信庁は６日、米メタ・プラットフォームズの写真共有アプリ「インスタグラム」の新機能「イン...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
英、米メタを調査　インスタの「インスタンツ」機能巡り 10/6 17:54 配信

写真はインスタグラムのロゴイメージ。8月13日撮影。REUTERS/Dado Ruvic

［６日　ロイター］ - 英情報通信庁は６日、米メタ・プラットフォームズの写真共有アプリ「インスタグラム」の新機能「インスタンツ（Instants）」を巡り調査を開始したと発表した。導入前にリスクを適切に評価しておらず、同国のオンライン安全関連法に違反した疑いがあるとした。

インスタンツは、利用者が共有したコンテンツが閲覧後に消去される機能で５月に導入された。

情報通信庁は、メタが新機能を導入する前に違法コンテンツのリスクや児童への潜在的リスクについて「適切かつ十分な」評価を実施したかどうかを確認する方針。

オフコムの執行責任者ジョージ・ラスティ氏は「われわれのオンライン安全法は明確だ。プラットフォームの重大な変更は立ち上げ前にリスク評価を受けなければならない」と述べた。

安全性は設計段階から組み込む必要があり、後付けするものではないと指摘。「本日の調査開始は、提供事業者がコンプライアンス違反の懸念がある場合、われわれが行動することを示している」とした。

メタは、オンライン安全法に基づく規制上の義務を真剣に受け止めているとし、調査に協力すると述べた。

同社の広報担当者は「リスク分析を実施した上で、導入前に何度もＯｆｃｏｍに同機能について説明した」と述べた。

「インスタンツには保護機能が組み込まれている。スクリーンショットや再共有、転送はできず、公開フィードもない。『ティーンアカウント』の保護機能も自動で有効になる」とした。

item.title: 仏高校デモが一部暴徒化、警察が催涙ガスで応戦 逮捕6100人に
item.description:
Inti Landauro
［ストラスブール／リヨン／パリ ６日 ロイター］ -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
Inti Landauro

［ストラスブール／リヨン／パリ　６日　ロイター］ - フランスでは６日、教員不足や校舎の老朽化への対策を求める全国の高校生らが校舎を封鎖した。今回の抗議活動で最大規模のデモが行われ、生徒や教員、保護者が街頭に繰り出した。警察は高校を封鎖する抗議参加者に催涙ガスを発射した。

マルセイユやナントでは、参加者が「国が教育を壊した」などと書かれたプラカードを掲げ、デモはおおむね平穏に行われた。トゥールーズでは、保護者が腕を組んで市内を行進するデモ隊の先頭に立った。

一方、ストラスブール、リヨン、レンヌではデモが時折、暴力的な衝突に発展。抗議参加者が路上で火を付けたりする事態となり、警察が催涙ガスを発射して鎮圧に乗り出した。

抗議活動は２週間前にパリ郊外の貧困地区で始まり、全国に広がった。学校前では、１０代の生徒らがごみ箱で築いたバリケードの上に立った。パリでは「催涙ガスではなく、私たちの声に耳を傾けて」「私たちの未来を後回しにするな」と書いた横断幕が掲げられた。

高校生団体によると、国内の高校の半数超が封鎖されるか、この日は休校となる見通し。一部の地方教育当局は授業のオンライン移行を試みている。

＜逮捕者は数千人に＞

政府は、抗議活動が都市部での暴力行為に変質したとして、機動隊を投入した。

内務省によると、抗議活動の開始以来６１００人が逮捕され、圧倒的多数が未成年だった。未成年１４８３人を含む１８００人超が訴追されているが、司法省は罪名は明らかにしていない。首相府によると、衝突で少なくとも警察官７１５人と１０代の若者２１５人が負傷した。

人権団体や生徒、保護者団体は、当局が未成年者に対して過剰な実力行使をしていると非難。一方、政府は、抗議活動が部外者に乗っ取られ、都市部での暴力行為に変質したと主張している。

大統領選を６カ月後に控え、政府と極右政党・国民連合は、急進左派「不服従のフランス」（ＬＦＩ）の議員や市長らが抗議活動をあおっていると非難している。ＬＦＩはこうした非難を否定している。

item.title: ユーロ圏金利上昇、エネ価格の波及を抑制＝フィンランド中銀総裁
item.description: [ヘルシンキ ６日 ロイター] - 欧州中央銀行（ＥＣＢ）理事会メンバーのレーン・フィンランド中銀総裁は６日、ユーロ...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
ユーロ圏金利上昇、エネ価格の波及を抑制＝フィンランド中銀総裁 10/6 17:42 配信

写真は欧州中央銀行（ＥＣＢ）理事会メンバーのレーン・フィンランド中銀総裁。2019年5月、英ロンドンで撮影。REUTERS/Hannah McKay

[ヘルシンキ ６日 ロイター] - 欧州中央銀行（ＥＣＢ）理事会メンバーのレーン・フィンランド中銀総裁は６日、ユーロ圏全体で急速に進んでいるエネルギー価格の上昇はまだ他の財やサービスには波及しておらず、最近の債券利回りの上昇は成長を圧迫することで物価上昇圧力を和らげる可能性が高いと述べた。

多くの政策当局者がインフレリスクは予想よりも高めに傾いていると指摘する中、レーン氏は、経済には相反する力が働いているため、他にも考慮すべき点があると指摘。「長期金利の上昇は成長の鈍化につながるだけでなく、エネルギー価格が他の物価や賃金に波及する度合いを弱めている」と語った。

また、人工知能（ＡＩ）への力強い投資などにより、経済が並外れた強靭性を示しているとも指摘した。

一部の政策当局者はこうした強靭性について、これまで考えられていたよりも強い物価上昇圧力を示唆していると指摘している。

item.title: Kenya confirms first Ebola case imported from Congo after man dies in Nairobi
item.description: Kenya confirmed its first Ebola case on Tuesday after a Kenyan citizen who had travelled from Democratic Republic of Congo died in Nairobi.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Kenya confirmed its first Ebola case on Tuesday after a Kenyan citizen who had travelled from Democratic Republic of Congo died in Nairobi. Kenya is the fourth country to record a case linked to the Ebola epidemic in eastern Congo, the [USN:L1N45O094 TEXT:"second largest on record"] with more than 8,000 cases. Uganda reported 20 cases and two deaths earlier in the year but was declared Ebola-free in August. A doctor who [USN:L8N42W0OV TEXT:"returned to France"] in June from Congo tested positive but there was no further spread of the virus. The Kenyan patient, who had lived in Congo for seven years, had been ill for about a month before travelling by road from Congo to Uganda's capital, Kampala, and then flying to Nairobi on Saturday, Kenya's Health Minister Aden Duale told a news conference. After arriving at Nairobi's international airport, he passed through health screening and was later taken by a relative to Nairobi Hospital. He was admitted with fever, chills and bleeding beneath the skin and was quickly placed in isolation, Duale said. He died late on Monday. The Africa Centres for Disease Control and Prevention said in a statement that it was immediately sending a high-level team to Kenya to provide support, adding that the case "underscores the importance of sustained preparedness across the region". World Health Organization Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus said on X that WHO was supporting the Kenyan and Ugandan governments and recommended against any travel restrictions on countries affected by the outbreak. PATIENT TO BE BURIED ON TUESDAY The patient was due to be buried later on Tuesday under protocols designed to prevent further spread of the virus, Duale said. Health authorities have identified 28 people he came into contact with in Kenya, including relatives and healthcare workers. They are trying to trace another 23 passengers and four crew members who were on his Jambojet flight, Duale said. Duale said Kenya had trained nearly 5,000 health workers across the country on prevention and management and the UN's senior Ebola coordinator, Julien Harneis, told Reuters he expected a "solid health response" from Kenya to manage the disease. Nevertheless, the incident raised questions about measures meant to prevent the spread of the virus across borders. Kenya's health ministry director general, Patrick Amoth, said the patient may have passed through airport screening because medication had masked his symptoms. It was also not clear how he had crossed from Congo into Uganda, given that the border has been closed since May. Africa CDC said he spent a night in Uganda before boarding the flight to Kenya. Asked about this, Ugandan government spokesperson Alan Kasujja said he had no idea what the man's condition was while in Uganda. "Leave Uganda out of this conversation," he said in a text message. "We don't have Ebola here." KENYA HOSTS US EBOLA QUARANTINE FACILITY After the outbreak was declared in Congo, the United States built a 50-bed Ebola quarantine camp for US citizens on an air force base in central Kenya. The facility is currently empty and has only housed seven people. Kenyan officials have said it could receive Kenyans and other nationalities, but the US government has not confirmed that. Ebola spreads through direct contact with the bodily fluids of infected people, whether living or dead. The disease can cause fever, vomiting, diarrhoea and, in severe cases, internal and external bleeding. The outbreak in Congo was declared in mid-May but may have started months earlier. Caused by the rare Bundibugyo strain, it has been blamed for more than 4,000 deaths .

item.title: Former German spy chief arrested for attempted treason, obtaining state secrets
item.description: Former German spy chief August Hanning was detained on Tuesday on suspicion of attempted treason in a case that ranks among Germany's biggest intelligence scandals since the Cold War.
item.dc:creator: Friederike Heine
item.content:encoded: Former German spy chief August Hanning was detained on Tuesday on suspicion of attempted treason in a case that ranks among Germany's biggest intelligence scandals since the Cold War. Prosecutors accused him of paying for secret documents and using them in an analysis for a foreign spy service. They did not identify the intelligence service and it was not immediately clear whether the analysis reached its intended recipient. The arrest of a former head of Germany's foreign intelligence is unprecedented and could damage the country's intelligence relationships with allied nations, according to a senior security lawmaker. "Hanning is strongly suspected of treasonous espionage, obtaining state secrets, attempted treason and espionage," the prosecutor's office said in a statement. Hanning did not respond to a request for comment from Reuters. The chancellery declined to comment. Five years after his seven-year tenure as head of the BND foreign intelligence service ended in 2005, Hanning agreed with a former BND office manager to receive confidential intelligence information in exchange for payment, according to prosecutors. The office manager, identified as Manfred D. in line with privacy rules, was also arrested on Tuesday, and both were due to appear before a judge at the Federal Court of Justice. Manfred D. served as office manager to successive BND presidents until March 2026, potentially giving him access to some of Germany's most current intelligence at the time that prosecutors say documents were being siphoned from the service. 'NO COMPROMISES' Prosecutors said D. is suspected of having supplied around 2,000 documents over the years, including classified material intended solely for internal use within the BND and senior-level intelligence briefings at the chancellery. Those included documents relating to the Iranian nuclear programme and the Russian military, as well as highly sensitive material classified as secret by allied intelligence agencies in other countries, Sueddeutsche Zeitung (SZ) newspaper reported. Prosecutors said Hanning had used classified information supplied by D. to prepare an analysis for an officer of a foreign intelligence service and for years shared political information with a representative of the spy agency. The case does not involve Russia, according to information obtained by Sueddeutsche Zeitung. Conservative security expert Roderich Kiesewetter told the Handelsblatt newspaper on Tuesday that the case could strain relations with Germany's intelligence allies, saying espionage cases of this kind were "particularly burdensome for trust and particularly damaging for Germany". BND President Martin Jaeger said the agency had launched extensive internal investigations as soon as suspicions emerged, adding, "There can be no compromises on internal security." PAST SPY SCANDALS Hanning's arrest is the latest in a series of notorious espionage scandals in Germany. West German Chancellor Willy Brandt was forced to resign in 1974 after it was revealed that an East German spy had worked as his close aide for nearly two years. In 1990, senior West German counter-intelligence official Klaus Kuron was exposed as a Stasi spy and later convicted of treason. More recently, former domestic intelligence chief Hans-Georg Maassen said in 2024 he was now being monitored by the security agency he once ran over alleged right-wing political extremism, which he denied.

item.title: France's Mistral launches AI model it says outperforms some Chinese rivals
item.description: French AI startup Mistral unveiled a new AI model on Tuesday, ending a gap of about five months between major releases, and said it outperforms many rival open-weight models.
item.dc:creator: Elizabeth Howcroft, Leo Marchandon
item.content:encoded: French AI startup Mistral unveiled a new AI model on Tuesday, ending a gap of about five months between major releases, and said it outperforms many rival open-weight models. The three-year-old company, widely viewed as Europe's strongest AI challenger to US and [USN:L8N43M04P TEXT:"Chinese competitors"], has not released a new model since May. In August, it began offering third-party models to customers, starting with Beijing-based Z.ai's GLM 5.3. "The model we're actually announcing today is actually above the Chinese models on certain aspects, including cyber. So the narrative that Europe cannot compete is something that is not true," CEO Artur Mensch said at a launch event in Abu Dhabi, without specifying which Chinese models or benchmarks he was referring to. Mistral said Le Chonk, officially named Mistral Large 4, will be made publicly available on October 27. Before the release, cybersecurity experts and government authorities will be given access to a version with fewer safety restrictions to test its capabilities, the company said. Pierre Stock, Mistral's vice president of science, told Reuters that the model ranks among the strongest open-weight, systems available. Open-weight means users can download the model from platforms and run it on their own hardware. Many Chinese models are open-weight, while top US models tend to be closed and accessible only through their developers' infrastructure. SAFETY RISKS CONTAINED Stock told Reuters the model had tried to go beyond its testing environment, but that this was expected and the company was able to prevent it. OpenAI and Anthropic, whose most advanced models have demonstrated [USN:L6N43X166 TEXT:"similar behaviour"] in testing, have restricted access to their most cyber-capable systems. After executives at US AI companies warned last month that AI could pose an existential threat to humanity, Mensch [USN:L6N4580UO TEXT:"dismissed"] such arguments as self-serving. Mistral, which raised €3 billion ($3.4 billion) [USN:L6N44Z0PP TEXT:"in its latest funding round"], has positioned itself as a safer, European alternative. 'CLOSING THE GAP' Mistral said Large 4 is "closing the gap with frontier models" in areas including coding, finance, geospatial analysis, manufacturing and product design. The company trained the model on its own infrastructure. Stock said Mistral's goal was to partner "very deeply" with backers including [USN:L2N3UW06X TEXT:"ASML"] and new-investor [USN:L6N44Z0PP TEXT:"Samsung"] "across the entire value chain". He said Large 4 is capable of designing computer chips, but declined to comment on whether Mistral is currently working with Samsung on chip development. ($1 = 0.8883 euros)

item.description:
(本文３段落目の「２５年度」を「２００５年度」に訂正します)
Makiko Yamazaki Takaya Yamag...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
訂正-インタビュー：個人向け国債「桁違い」に拡大する必要＝自民・中西氏 10/6 17:27 配信

写真は円紙幣のイメージ。2022年11月、都内で撮影。REUTERS/Kim Kyung-Hoon

(本文３段落目の「２５年度」を「２００５年度」に訂正します)

Makiko Yamazaki　Takaya Yamaguchi

［東京　６日　ロイター］ - 自民党の中西健治議員は６日、国債発行全体に占める個人向け販売を「桁違い」に拡大する必要があると述べた。税優遇を含む商品設計の見直しを通じ、国債消化の柱のひとつに据える考えを強調した。ロイターとのインタビューで語った。

財務省が６日発表した１０月発行分の個人向け国債（１０年変動、５年固定、３年固定）は１兆０２５１億円だった。

年度ベースでは累計６兆１６４１億円となり、当初計画（５兆９０００億円）をすでに上回った。過去最大だった２００５年度（訂正、７兆２７１２億円）を上回るペースにある。

ただ、中西氏は「もっと買ってもらえる余地はある」と強調。「そのための後押しは必要」との考えを述べた。

日銀が国債買い入れを減らす中、２０００兆円を超える家計の金融資産をどう取り込むかは、今後の財政運営を占う試金石となる。金利上昇に伴う個人向け国債の売れ行きは好調だが、保有比率は依然として低い。

中西氏はインタビューで、税優遇を含む商品設計の見直しにも言及。利回り曲線が傾斜化し、超長期債利回りが「魅力的な水準になってきている。（１０年を超える）長いものも、あったらいい」としている。

item.title: サウジの2空港が5日に攻撃受ける、フーシ派との対立激化する中
item.description: [ドバイ ６日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
[ドバイ ６日 ロイター] - サウジアラビア航空当局によると、イエメンの親イラン武装組織フーシ派との対立が激化する中、ジャザンとナジュランにあるサウジの２空港が５日に攻撃の標的となり、３人が負傷し、限定的な被害が出た。

当局は被害状況を確認しており、乗客や職員の安全、サウジ民間航空システムの安全確保に向けた措置を講じていると述べた。

item.title: インフレ二次的効果、現時点でそれほど強くない＝ＥＣＢ専務理事
item.description: [フランクフルト ６日 ロイター] - 欧州中央銀行（ＥＣＢ）チーフエコノミストのレーン専務理事はイタリアの通信社Ａ...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
インフレ二次的効果、現時点でそれほど強くない＝ＥＣＢ専務理事 10/6 17:02 配信

欧州中央銀行（ECB）チーフエコノミストのレーン専務理事。6月16日、ロンドンで撮影。REUTERS/Chris J. Ratcliffe

[フランクフルト ６日 ロイター] - 欧州中央銀行（ＥＣＢ）チーフエコノミストのレーン専務理事はイタリアの通信社ＡＮＳＡに対し、ユーロ圏における高いエネルギーコストはまだ二次的なインフレ効果をもたらしておらず、そうした効果の強さも不透明だと述べた。

６日に配信されたインタビューで「現時点では、それほど強い二次的効果は見られていない。引き続き注視している」と説明。「私自身はさまざまなシナリオを提唱している立場ではあるが、われわれが『悪化シナリオ』にあるとか、『基本シナリオ』にあると断言するのはあまりに短絡的だ」と語った。

「エネルギー価格は高いが、経済の他の分野への波及の強さは依然として不透明だ」と付け加えた。

ロイター 関連ニュース 焦点：債務膨張の先進国に金融危機の芽、最も懸念される米・伊・英 アングル：欧州熱波、損害保険未カバーの企業損失が拡大 アングル：トランプ氏がＮＡＴＯ首脳会議で見せた硬軟2つの顔、各国は冷静対応 アングル：トランプ氏賛美から一転、 戦略転換迫られるメローニ氏 アングル：インド「高級水」市場が急成長、富裕層にブーム到来 最終更新: 10/6(火) 17:02 ロイター

item.description: LONDON, Oct 6 : Britain's communications regulator opened its first formal investigation into Meta under the Online Safety Act on Tuesday, questioning whether it properly assessed risks posed by its Instagram Instants feature before launching it in May.Instants allows content shared by users on Instagram to d
item.dc:creator: CNA

UK watchdog opens first Online Safety Act probe into Meta

Instagram app icon is seen on a smartphone in this illustration taken October 27, 2025. REUTERS/Dado Ruvic/Illustration

FAST

LONDON, Oct 6 : Britain's communications regulator opened its first formal investigation into Meta under the Online Safety Act on Tuesday, questioning whether it properly assessed risks posed by its Instagram Instants feature before launching it in May. Instants allows content shared by users on Instagram to disappear after being viewed. Ofcom said its investigation would establish whether Meta carried out a "suitable and sufficient" assessment of the risks of illegal content on the feature and any risks posed to children before its launch. George Lusty, director of enforcement at Ofcom, said: "Our online safety laws are clear — significant changes to platforms must be risk assessed before they're launched."

Safety by design had to be built in and not bolted on, he said. "Today's investigation shows we'll take action where we have concerns that providers are failing to comply," he said. Meta said it took its regulatory obligations under the Online Safety Act seriously. "We conducted a risk analysis and briefed Ofcom about this feature on a number of occasions before launching it," a spokesperson said. "Instants has in-built protections, including blocking screenshots, reshares and forwarding, no public feed, and Teen Account protections on automatically." "We will of course co-operate with Ofcom during this investigation," the spokesperson said. Ofcom's first investigation under the Online Safety Act was into an online suicide discussion forum last year, followed by probes into pornography sites, file-sharing services used to distribute child sexual abuse material, and platforms such as 4chan. Britain's online safety regime sets obligations for social media platforms, search engines and adult content providers to tackle illegal content and to protect children's safety. Ofcom requires companies to conduct risk assessments and implement safety measures, such as age verification. If a company fails to comply, Ofcom can impose fines of up to £18 million or 10 per cent of qualifying worldwide revenue, whichever is greater. Meta has launched legal challenges against Ofcom over its implementation of the act, including the scale and scope of information it has to provide to the regulator and the level of fees Ofcom charges. In January, Ofcom launched an investigation into Meta over the provision of information about its WhatsApp Business product under a separate Communications Act.

Source: Reuters
